name: Run In The Park
description:
Come and join the original Zwift group run! 

This event is a 5km mass start event and runs at multiple times every Saturday.  

It is open to runners of all abilities so whether you are a recreational runner or an elite athlete you are welcome on the start line.  

Get to the start gates early to chat with the other runners, you may find someone of a similar ability to group up with for the run.  

There is no time limit for completing the event so run at your own pace and enjoy the course.

name: T-VGN 🌱 Rubberband Ride
description:
This event is open to everyone, vegan and non-vegan. Our rides are always chatty and supportive, so if you have any questions, just ask.

This event has “rubberbanding” enabled, so you will stay with the group as long as you keep pedaling. Feel free to go as hard or as easy as you like for the duration.

name: PACK Run Hill Training: Surrey
description:
PACK Beginner Hill Training is a group workout designed to help runners get familiar with running with incline. This is a free run event meaning there is no set pace you must go, but there will be incline prompts that attempt to mimic the terrain of the course. The inclines are based on distance, so you will always be given prompts based on your progression in the workout. If some of the gradients are too challenging for you, feel free to decrease the incline, but don't make it too easy. The leader will typically follow the pace chart below, but may adjust depending on the group dynamics.

Note: We will not always be matching Zwift gradients, so it is important to pay attention to the instructions. Typically the adjusted incline will be half of what is being displayed in the upper righthand corner.

As a general guide: 
--------------------------
0 - 1% = 10.2kph / 6.3 mph
2% - 9.9 kph / 6.2 mph
3% = 9.7 kph / 6.0 mph
4% = 9.3 kph / 5.8 mph 
5% = 9 kph / 5.6 mph
6% = 8.7 kph / 5.4 mph
7% = 7.4 kph / 5.2 mph
--------------------------

If you'd like Zwift to record your elevation in the fit file, you'll need to either have a direct connect treadmill or use an app like Pascal's Runcline for iOS, TSS app for iOS, or Runn module from North Pole Engineering.

Finally, if the hills don't wear you out, there will be an optional 500 meter sprint to the finish and optional after party of 2-4km to boot!

So put PACK in your name, get your black shirt and shorts on, and let's tackle those hills!

https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftpack/

name: NPRC - Run Every Day Powered By NoblePro
description:
Come and join the fastest growing running club on Zwift.  With a choice of 5 or 10k you can pick your distance. Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it’s not a race unless you want it to be!

Each day is a different route and as new routes are released the courses will change to allow you to bag that badge.

You will run in our in game NPRC jersey and if you complete the event you get to keep it to wear wherever you like.

We also hold special events where you can win an actual jersey to wear in real life.

NPRC Facebook – We have a facebook group where you can join and talk about all things running.  Share your stories and get help and advice.

https://www.facebook.com/groups/1223724692417314/

NoblePro: - We are a team focused on elevating running through our treadmills and digital platforms. We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

Kinni:- In a fitness world where treadmill bluetooth integration can be a confusing place, we aim to provide you with the ability to effortlessly connect. You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.
https://kinni.co/https://kinni.co/devices/ - To see if your treadmill is compatible to link to Zwift.

Join the NoblePro Running Club (NPRC) - https://www.zwift.com/clubs/e7829ccd-bce4-4244-9ccf-4cdc3ef148ff/home

name: JETT Endurance Ride 100km 2.5~3.3w/kg
description:
JETT Endurance Ride !!
Let's ride 2.5w/kg~3.3w/kg !!
B category's average of power is 3.0~3.3w/kg, start is 2.5w/kg for grouping.
C category's average of power is 2.5~2.9w/kg, start is 2.0w/kg for grouping.

Double draft is on.

Rule of this group ride
· You always keep grouping in mind
· Do not Lead from Leader - yellow beacon
· Keep stay around Yellow Beacon
· TT Bike is allowed but TT bike cant get drafting effect.
· If you exceed the Fence, return to Yellow Beacon at 2.0w/kg or less.

*There are several Sweepers on this group ride. If you have dropped, please
request 'Help' in ZWIFT Chat if you need help. A sweeper goes for help.
However, we can not help without the offer of 'HElp'.

Follow endurance ride for 2 hours and 30 minutes, follow leader
instructions and enjoy ZWIFT chat, let's work together and make the best
group, the best workout!

※Please note that we will flag you if you lead at abnormal speed.

JETT Endurance Ride
休日の朝を100kmを2.5w/kg~3.3w/kgでライドしましょう！
B categoryの平均パワーは、3.0~3.3w/kgです。スタートは2.5w/kgでグルーピングします。
C categoryの平均パワーは、2.5~2.9w/kgです。スタートは2.0w/kgでグルーピングします。

ダブルドラフトはオンです。

このグループライドのルール
・常にグルーピングを心がけること
・Yellow Beaconから離れないでライドしましょう
・TT Bikeは使用可能ですが、Drafting効果を得られません。
・Fenceをオーバーした場合は、2.0w/kg以下でYellow Beaconまで戻りましょう。

*このグループライドにはスイーパーが何名かいます。もし，ドロップしてしまった時，支援が必要な時はZWIFT
Chatで'Help'と申し出てください。スイーパーが助けに行きます。しかし，'HElp’の申し出がない限り助けには行けません。
2時間30分の耐久ライド、リーダー指示に従い、またZWIFTチャットを楽しみながら、みんなで協力し最高のグループ、最高のワークアウトにしましょう！

※異常なスピードでリードした場合、あなたにフラグを立てますので注意して下さい。

#jett #japan

name: AHDR Social Sundays
description:
The best way to start a Sunday group ride is Social.

Come along & join in the adventure and good times with your AHDR friends for a "Social Sunday" group ride to start off your day (or end it, timezone dependent).

Each week we will cruise socially at 2.5-3.0W/kg (ride leader average, W/kg will be slightly higher on climbs) with plenty of chat & banter to bring extra joy and fitness to your weekend.

NB: We’ll mix it up week to week with lumps, bumps plus some flatter route options so please check each week’s route carefully.

Positioning close to our Beacon will bring you the best experience and draft.

(Join/Rejoin up to 30mins).

#AHDR

name: Tiny Race (1 of 4) by Zwift Insider
description:
IMPORTANT: read these notes to perform your best and avoid disqualification!

Tiny Races are mean to be raced as set of 4 back-to-back events that finish within one hour. Each race is on a different route that takes ~7-12 minutes to complete, and races are scheduled 15 minutes apart.

3 RULES:
- No skipping then returning. You will receive a DQ if you skip race 1, 2, or 3 but finish a later race in the set.
- You must have an active ZwiftPower account to compete for the overall podium.
- Smart trainer or power meter is required.

THIS WEEK'S ROUTES:
Race 1: Croissant (3.241km, ends at Dos d'Âne Sprint Reverse) - Powerup: Draft Boost
Race 2: Gentil 8 (6.877km, ends at Ballon Sprint) - Powerup: Draft Boost
Race 3: Hell of the North (6.242km, ends at Dos d'Âne Sprint) - Powerup: Aero Boost
Race 4: Bon Voyage (6.716km, ends at Sprinteur Sprint Reverse) - Powerup: Aero Boost


PRO TIPS: 
You will receive a single powerup at the start of each race, as listed above. Be sure to visit https://zwiftinsider.com/tiny/ for details on this week's routes, including custom finish line locations.

RESULTS:
You earn points in each race based on your finishing position. The overall category winners each week (available on ZwiftPower) are the riders with the most points across all 4 races. ZwiftPower result links:
- Zone 1 (9am UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1172
- Zone 2 (3pm UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1173
- Zone 3 (9pm UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1174

name: RollCo: Rolling Tide - 26K
description:
🌊 ROLLING TIDE
Start small. Build big.
Welcome to Rolling Tide — RollCo’s season-long ritual race.

Every week, the distance grows by 1 km.
It begins as a short, explosive opener and steadily evolves into a full-distance endurance epic by year’s end.
This isn’t a one-off event — it’s a shared journey that rises with you.

🏁 Race Format
Rolling Tide is a categorised scratch race.
All riders start together, with categories keeping the racing fair and fast.
The only thing that changes… is the distance.

Week 1 → 1 km
Week 52 → 52 km

Early weeks reward raw power.
Later weeks demand patience, grit, and endurance.
The tide never stops rising.

Rolling Tide is about more than today’s finish line.
It’s about showing up — week after week.
Seeing the same names.
Measuring how far you’ve come as the distance stretches.

You’ll build rivalries.
You’ll track your progress.
You’ll remember the day it all began.

And by the end of the season, everyone who stayed will share the same truth:

“We rode the whole tide together.”

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our WEEKEND WARRIOR which build on the Classica races and the full series to mid August.

Each event will offer 3 races Friday to Sunday, using three formats - iTT / Scratch / Points - each race will convert to points, based on segments and finish - a riders points total will be drawn from all 3 races, do more, score more!

Rules

Event Basics

name: Paceline Work
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

This is a great workout for mimicking the demands of working in a paceline. Although gravel events feature mainly off-road and gnarly terrain, they also typically have asphalt and smoother dirt roads. Being able to stay in and work with a group as the speed inevitably increases over this terrain is crucial to achieve maximum speed due to the aerodynamic advantage gained.

WORKOUT DESIGNER

Shayne Gaffney (GC Coaching) holds a bachelors degree in Health Science in Professional Development and Advanced Patient Care, is a USA Cycling Level 1 (expert level) Certified Coach, a level 2 certified Training Peaks coach, a USA Cycling certified power based training coach, USA Olympic Committee Safe Sport Certified, and a licensed physical therapist assistant.  He is also the creator of Zwift's "Build Me Up" Flexible Training Plan.  He can be contacted directly via  for any cycling or training related questions.

For more information on GC Coaching, please visit www.gaffneycyclingcoaching.com

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: Herd Summer Racing League
description:
Welcome to the Herd Summer Racing League (HSRL)

HSRL is a series of points races. The race format can be a little bit different week to week, but in most of the races you score points for your time on each of the segments (FTS), versus the times set by the other competitors. You also score bonus points for your finishing position in the race versus your competitors in your category. Each week the race format, segments and points for this race will be posted at the Herd Racing League facebook group and on the Herd Racing discord channel. 

General Classification
The points in each race are used to determine your ranking for the race. Your race rank determines how many league points you receive, with the winner scoring 50 points, 2nd place getting 49 and so on, down to 1 point for 50th place. Each week there are six different events to choose from - choose whichever suits your schedule best.

Schedule
26-28 June: Bologna TT (1 lap, 8.0km) - ITT
3-5 July: Peaky Pave (1 lap, 30.8km) - Points race FTS + FIN
10-12 July: Toefield Tornado (3 laps, 30.6km) - Points race FTS + FIN
17-19 July: Royal Pump Room 8 (1 lap, 27.5km) - Scratch race
24-26 July: 2018 Worlds Short Lap (1 lap, 23.8km) - Points race FTS + FIN
31 July-2 August: Cobbled Crown (1 lap, 24.3km) - Points race FTS + FIN
7-9 August: The Bell Lap (12 laps, 24.0km) - Points race FAL + FIN
14-16 August: Paris finale, course TBA - Points race FTS + FIN

Race rules:
Steering is disabled
Smarttrainer or powermeter required.
Cadence sensor required.
Heart rate monitor required.
No indoor bikes without controlled resistance (cadence=power).
Participants must be registered on zwiftpower.com to be included in the results.
For elite level performances the race organiser can request additional data to verify the performance.
For podium finishers in all categories: Zwift activities must be saved PUBLIC for verification.

For more information please see our Facebook Group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerdRacing

name: The Grind Finale
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

This session aims to replicate the demands of a mountain bike ride / event. 

Mountain biking generally involves far more variations in effort compared with road riding - so plenty of surges and time spent being over geared! We also spend a lot of time on and off the power, so short spells going  hard to get over an obstacle, followed by a freewheel or very low power on a descent or little dip.

We touch upon all of these aspects in todays session, as we start off alternating every 30 seconds between riding hard at a low cadence, and riding easy - as if we are riding through an undulating single track. Then we make a ramp in effort, which finishes with a 30 second near max effort up a steep, rocky banking!

WORKOUT DESIGNER

Matt Rowe - Heavily involved in cycling for the past 25 years, Matt represented Great Britain at the Junior World Championships before graduating to the pro ranks. Matt draws on his extensive race experience to help amateur cyclists around the world achieve their personal goals. 

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: INC Summer Endurance Ride Series
description:
INC Winter Endurance Ride – Sundays 5:30 AM (CET) 

 Do you measure rides in days, not hours? 
Do you know what it means to push through the night – chasing the horizon, legs on autopilot, mind in flow? 


Then welcome to the tribe. The Winter Endurance Ride is a steady, social endurance session for everyone who rides far – really far. This ride is for:  Randonneurs & Brevet riders who think 600k is just getting started, Transcontinental racers & ultra-distance addicts who live for the long haul, Bikepackers & 24-hour riders who know the beauty (and the madness) of riding through fatigue.  

And everyone else who just wants to challenge themselves with a solid 2–5 hour endurance session. We roll steady at 2.7–3.1 W/kg for 2–5 hours – no surges, no chaos, just that perfect endurance rhythm. The goal: build endurance, build mental strength, and share the mindset that defines true long-distance riders. 

 We talk routes, gear, sleep strategies, and the art of suffering with style. Whether you’re training for the next TCR, a 1200k brevet, or just want to ride steady with people who get it – this is your place. Ride steady. Ride far. Ride together. The long game starts here.

description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our WEEKEND WARRIOR which build on the Classica races and the full series to mid August.

Each event will offer 3 races Friday to Sunday, using three formats - iTT / Scratch / Points - each race will convert to points, based on segments and finish - a riders points total will be drawn from all 3 races, do more, score more!

Each event will center around the type of course and terrain of the monument, with the actual race day event being of a length that is fitting for the monument.

Rules

- Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform

- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.

name: OTR Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time
description:
Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time is a group ride, race & interval training all rolled into one fun challenging event. Unique “race” scoring, where results in ZwiftPower are based on sum of segment times on a route with punchy climbs and/or sprints. Group rides together at ~2wkg, and ride leader provides guidance and lead-outs to smash a segment; then regroup, rinse & repeat. New route every week.

Multiple time slots on Fri-Sun, including Fri Atlantic, Sun APAC and Sun Americas/EMEA.
Riders need to join ZwiftPower.com to see their results as sum of segment times.

Event links: https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/snapcracklepop
Weekly results (across all time slots): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=2656
In-ride conversation (“SCP Ride” channel): https://discord.gg/B52qdExaW2
Chat, banter and results: https://discord.gg/HNzvx98srF

Group ride with all cats together at ~2w/kg. Yellow beacon / ride leader (when present) will provide instructions for each segment, and drop the fence when it's time to punch/sprint. Fence is for guidance only (non-zapping).

Ride at a relaxed pace between the timed segments.
Work together to optimize draft for faster segment times.
Slow or stop with yellow beacon after each segment to regroup.

All categories start in a single pen.
Results split per WKG category in ZwiftPower.
No power ups, default drafting, no TT bikes.

One of our regular SCP routes is 3.5 laps of Innsbruckring, with 4x Leg Snappers plus 3x sprints (stopping to regroup on the kicker in between). The challenge is to achieve sub 4 mins for the sum of 7 segment times for cats A/B (that's 45 secs per snapper plus 20 secs per sprint), sub 5 mins for cat C, and sub 7 mins for cat D. Best time to beat is 3:33.
Historical results for Leg Snapper: https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1322

name: ZLDR AYOP Event
description:
Join Zwift Long-Distance Runners (ZLDR) run club for a nice AYOP (at your own pace) event. Whether you want to push for a new personal best, use it as part of your weekly training program or just enjoy a sociable event this is suitable for you.

ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. We are here to support your running dreams and help you develop your running skills. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners and walkers who want to help you set and achieve new goals!

For more ZLDR fun and support, join our groups on social media platforms:

Facebook Group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/ZLDR2020
Strava Club: https://www.strava.com/clubs/zldr2020
Instagram page: https://www.instagram.com/zldr.2020/
Discord Invitation (not required for the run)
https://discord.com/invite/PuFctEnWyn
ZLDR website for Challenge Months: https://www.zldr.club
Online shop: https://www.sweatydino.com

name: Rowe & King - Fire Breather
description:
This is a group ride, with a difference! It will be 80 minutes, with the final 10 minutes a free for all race to the last second! 

The format of the ride is as follows;
10 Minutes easy as a warm up
20 Minutes ramped effort, to 85% of FTP
5 Minutes easy
3 x (20s Max effort sprint - 3 Minutes easy)
20 Minutes ramp down from 85% of FTP
10 Minutes full gas race
5 Minutes cool down

About Rowe & King Coaching:

The Rowe & King team are highly experienced cyclists and qualified coaches. Whether your goals are to become a professional cyclist, gain a 2nd cat licence, complete a sportive, perform at a specific event or simply becoming a better bike rider with a healthier lifestyle Rowe & King are ready to help you become a better cyclist, whatever that may mean to you.

Launched in 2015 Rowe & King, which has since grown to a team of 11 who help riders improve and work towards achieving their goals.

About - Rowe & King (roweandking.com) https://roweandking.com/about-rowe-and-king-cycling-coaching

name: The Stampede Challenge by Herd Racing
description:
Join Herd Racing for our monthly TT challenge. For the month of January
it's 2 laps of Handful of Gravel. You can race this as many times as you'd
like and try to beat your time and your best time counts in the monthly
standings https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=3093

For these events drafting is turned off, so it's just you and the clock. Is
the gravel, the MTB or the TT bike fastest? Maybe even a road bike?!?!
Pick your fastest equipment and give it your best shot! Join us in the Herd
Racing League facebook or Discord server to chat pacing strategies, gear,
and more.
https://discord.gg/DrAXaCb7Tq

name: ZTPL Cycling Club Psycho Poranek
description:
Zapraszamy na wspólny poranny event z ZTPL Cycling Club.
Z założenia nasze jazdy prowadzą liderzy, którzy pomagają trzymać peleton w ryzach. Jeśli podczas eventu zabraknie lidera, starajcie się trzymać tempo na które się umówiliśmy w momencie gdy dołączyliście do wybranej grupy. To od Was zależy jak będziecie się bawić 😊
Po ukończonym evencie, jeśli jechaliście z nami pierwszy raz, w Waszym wirtualnym garażu będzie czekała nasza teamowa koszulka!

◾️ Wartości podane w opisach dotyczą średniego tempa z CAŁEJ jazdy (nie uwzględniają interwałów, które mogą wystąpić podczas np. podjazdów)
◾️ PAMIĘTAJCIE, że podczas jazd grupowych NIE UŻYWAMY ROWERÓW CZASOWYCH!
◾️ Starajcie się pilnować peletonu i nie zgubić koła, samemu bardzo trudno jest odrobić stratę.
◾️ Proszę słuchajcie poleceń lidera, które podczas jazdy wyświetlane są na środku ekranu. Szczególnie jeśli lider zauważy że grupa się porwała.
◾️ Lider, który prowadzi grupę podświetlony jest na żółto.
◾️ Starajcie się jechać blisko lidera, starając się go nie wyprzedzać i nie wyjeżdżać przed bramę, która informuje Was że jedziecie za szybko.

◾️Podoba się Wam to co robimy? Zawsze możecie postawić Waszym kochanym administratorom oraz liderom naszych jazd wirtualną kawę :) https://buycoffee.to/ztplcc

name: Stage 4 - Tour Fever
description:
Set your alarms—it’s Tour Fever! Ride the Tour de France and Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift your way, with stages inspired by both races. Cruise it, spin it, or turn up the pace—just don’t miss a stage. 

Two iconic races. One global community. Let’s ride.

name: Liv du Tour Your Way
description:
Join us for a fun, social, banded group ride following the same route as the Liv du Tour racers. Whether you’re looking to enjoy the atmosphere, ride with friends, or simply celebrate cycling, this ride is for you—no racing, no pressure, just great company and shared miles.



This tour is a celebration of the Tour de France Femmes and the incredible women who inspire our sport. Everyone is welcome.



*Daily Routes (1–9 August 2026)



1 August – Downtown Dolphin (15 laps)
2 August – Magnificent 8 (29 km)
3 August – Chasing the Sun (35 km)
4 August – Epic Loch (2 laps)
5 August – Casse-Pattes (24 km)
6 August – Figure 8 Reverse (30 km)
7 August – Ven-Top (20.9 km)
8 August – Sugar Cookie (40 km)
9 August – Mayan 8 (26.2 km)

eventSubgroups.name: Liv du Tour Your Way (E)
eventSubgroups.description:
Join the Fishalicious banded ride for fun that's off the scale! 🎣 

Our mission is to push you further than before, build your endurance, and have fun. If you are feeling strong, push to the front and drag the group, if not, just sit in the peloton.

We have the "rubber-band" activated, which means that no matter what level you are, you will be able to keep up, and the group WILL STAY TOGETHER. The rubber band allows you to ride at your own pace, slow or fast, and you are guaranteed to stay in the group.

The ride speed may be slightly less than other group rides due to the rubber band effect, but that's a small price to pay to allow riders of all levels to remain together throughout the ride. We are all about teamwork, working together as a group, and we look forward to riding with you!

name: Stage 4 - Race - Tour Fever
description:
The race is on. Tour Fever brings the Tour de France and Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift together—now it’s your turn to race them. Full gas from the start, hold the wheel, and bring it to the line. Every stage counts.

TOUR FEVER STAGE REWARDS
1 Stage: Tour Fever Gloves + Socks
2 Stages: 500 XP
3 Stages: Tour Fever Helmet
4 Stages: 500 XP
5 Stages: Tour Fever Kit + Watch the Femmes Kit
ROUTE PROGRESSION REWARDS
7 Routes: 500 XP
10 Routes: Tour Fever Bucket Hat

—------------------

MONTHLY GC COMPETITION

Looking for extra motivation? The GC (General Classification) Competition lets you track your progress across all stages. Each race counts—your times add up throughout the series, shaping the overall standings. At the end of the series, the fastest total time takes the win!

VIEW RESULTS: http://zwift.com/racing/leagues/tourfever2026
—------------------

YOUR RACING PROFILE
Every race tells a story. Head to your Racing Profile on Zwift.com to track your performance, follow your progress, and see how your racing evolves over time. Review your results, compare key efforts, and build a deeper picture of your racing, race by race.
VIEW YOUR PROFILE: http://zwift.com/athlete/me
—------------------

Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh


ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter


Hourly Racing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: 3R Endurance Steady Ride
description:

We welcome good banter and aim to create a fun, social atmosphere for your training. name: LEQP Provence Badge Hunter Series
description:
Welcome to the L’Equipe Provence Badge Hunter Series! Our dedicated Team of Leaders and Sweepers created the concept of Zwift Badge Hunting and continue to refine, expand and perfect the art of the Hunt. Together, we share two goals: stacking badges and having fun! Whether this is your first time with us or you just want to tap into the contagious enthusiasm from a community of like-minded Zwifters, you’re in the right place. As a bonus, finish the Hunt and unlock the L’Equipe Provence Team Kit!

Teamwork makes the dreamwork! Stick together, use the group draft and encourage each other in the chat to get through these challenging rides. Group C will be between 2.5-3.2 w/kg and Group D will be between 2.0-2.5 wkg.

Visit our Team Shop:
https://jakroo.com/store-front?storeId=BJ2aA7Ay5#

Join our Facebook Group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/leqpprovencezwift/

Follow on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lequipeprovence/

Turn It Up! Add your favorite track to our Spotify Playlist!: https://tinyurl.com/y5ocfckc

Chat on our Discord Channel: https://discord.gg/a8TCFft

name: LGBTQz Ride with Pride
description:
Everyone is welcome to join LGBTQ Zwifters and friends as we Ride with Pride all
year round in our Sunday social ride.
Our social ride is all about togetherness and most rides will use the rubberband so
we can be one big, joyful bunch cruising the roads where everyone belongs. No
surges, no stress, no getting left behind.
If the leader isn’t using the rubberband, they will let you know, but they’ll aim to
maintain a social pace. You can check the event details to see if this is the case for
this ride by using the link 'Toggle Event Details' at the end of the event description on
zwift.com.
Ride leaders may have quizzes or other fun stuff planned for you, so please do get
involved using the companion app chat function.
Our rides are inclusive, we value diversity and courage, and we are always
respectful. Ride chat may involve LGBTQIA+ topics so please come with an open
heart and open mind. If you want to enjoy a relaxed ride with an amazing community,
this is your space. Ride proud, ride together, and let’s make the miles brighter.
If you want to learn more about what to expect on one of our rides, or find links to our
Club and socials, please visit: https://lgbtq-zwifters.com/

name: Hotchillee Race, Ride or Conquer Endurance ride
description:
The Hotchillee Race, Ride or Conquer ride is a series of Sunday morning endurance focussed races/rides that are a perfect way to get in a solid endurance session.

The routes will typically be in the 70-120 mins range but we might throw in some longer ones too.

The idea, just like a good sportive, is, no matter what your pace, you should find some wheels to ride with and, with double-draft enabled, should be able to hang on and tick that route off.

If you want a couple of spicy midweek rides, check out Hotchillee WOT (Watts on Tuesday) on Tuesdays at 1830 and the Hotchillee Gain Train at 1830 on Thursdays.

Check out Hotchillee IRL events and our community at *www.hotchillee.com*

description:
Stanga Sunday Endurance is all about winter base miles in good company. Settle into Zone 2, find the bunch, and let the kilometres roll by as we build steady fitness together. Expect a smooth pace and good vibes only – perfect for stacking winter endurance or spinning the legs after a hard week.

Like this format? Join the Stanga Racing club on Zwift for our full weekly schedule of crits, punchy races, and endurance rides.

name: ZSUN Endurance Enhancer
description:
Get ready to boost your stamina in ZSUN’s Endurance Enhancer! This steady, longer-duration ride is perfect for building resilience and preparing for harder events or races.

Targeting a pace of 2.4–2.7 w/kg over ~120 minutes, it’s ideal for developing aerobic capacity while riding with a focused, supportive group.

🗓️
Sunday AM | 120 mins | ~2.4–2.7 w/kg

🎯
Focus on endurance development

🚴‍♀️
Suitable for mid to high-level social riders

🎁
Complete the ride to earn your ZSUN kit

Let’s push our limits together – one pedal stroke at a time!

name: PACK Run: Smile for Miles
description:
PACK Run Smile for Miles is the answer to how to start your Sunday the right way. We will usually run one lap of a short route and then offer an after party for whatever distance you desire. Come for the banter, the confections, and smiles and leave with a sense of accomplishment and community. https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftpack/
#StrongerTogether #MaythePackBewithYou

name: PAOLO BARBERA & SCANNELLATORI SERIALI WORKOUT
description:
"Scannellatori Seriali" is a large community of cyclists, triathletes, and runners. We invite you to join our community by following our Instagram page at https://www.instagram.com/scannellatori_seriali/ or contacting us on Facebook.
 
Coach Paolo Barbera (Please visit www.heycoach.it )   is a Certified Triathlon and Ironman Coach and the founder of Active Kids, a sporting clinic to help children and adults in the prevention and treatment of obesity through healty nutrition and tailored training programs

Paolo is an experienced thriathlete and cyclist, in 2017 opened an endurance training center in milan, Tri60, specilized in indoor training.

In the last ten years Paolo has developed training programs for triathletes, runners and cyclists. Indoor training plays a key role to control pace, cadence and mental strenght.

Paolo’s workouts are designed to mix different training zones aiming to maximize results in a very short time. Paolo’s coachees by following his workouts, at the right intensity, have achieved challenging results.

name: Het is Koers in the Dutch mountains
description:
Het is Koers, the famous Dutch cycling blog presents you a variety of social rides. At Sunday morning we go "in the Dutch Mountains"
Between 1st Sunday of October until the last Sunday of March, we will offer you a medium paced endurance ride with social characteristics.
Meaning a ride leader will guide you through the hills and mountains that Zwift has to offer. All riders are encouraged to keep the bunch together, so we can start and finish as one happy blob.
On the flats we will ride about 2.5 w/kg and on the climbs around 3.0 w/kg reflecting a C-category ride.

Between 1st Sunday of April until last Sunday of September HIK presents you with a variety of free rides (no lead) through the Dutch mountains. On weekly basis you can ride with other C-category riders, wanting to ride uphill.
Check out our weekly ride announcements on the HIK Facebook https://www.facebook.com/groups/hetiskoers
Join Het Is Koers on Zwift https://www.zwift.com/clubs/HetIsKoers/home

name: ZU4R eSport Masochist Climber
description:
ZU4R Sportswear has the pleasure to invite you to the ZU4R eSport Masochist Climber series 2022. Here we will challenge, cheer on, support and put each other in competition, in a series of climbs up the Alpe du Zwift – Road to Sky.

In addition to the community, we have the following badges as objectives:
• Avid Climber: Climb the Alpe 5 times
• Masochist: Climb the Alpe 25 times
• Lift Off: Finish Alpe in under an hour
And of course - the climbing wheels: Lightweight Meilenstein, which you can get on the wheel of fortune at the top of AdZ. Collecting altitude meters for the Zwift Consept bike Z1 (Tron) bike can also be a goal for those who do not have this bike.

More information about ZU4R eSport: https://www.zu4resport.com
We use the Voice channel "Masochist Climber» at ZU4R eSport Discord-server: https://discord.gg/RMVde96aqb

Welcome – ride together – RIDE ON 👍

name: Watts More To the Top!
description:
Watts More! Ride with friends in challenging events. Take on your challenge in Watts, elevation or duration! 

At Sunday morning we go To the top! A rideleader will guide you through the hills and mountains that Zwift has to offer. On the flats we will ride about 2.5 w/kg and on the climbs around 3.0 w/kg reflecting a C-category ride. All riders are encouraged to keep the bunch together, so we can start and finish as one happy blob. During the season we build up the elevation meters. 

From October until March these rides are guided with a rideleader. From April until September the rides are without rideleader. In that case don’t argue, blob up and be nice.  
 
Check out our weekly ride announcements on the Watts More Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/1151203888657006/?ref=share 

 Join Watts More on Zwift  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/d6afeaa7-e754-478a-b68d-2a794648fa02/home  

 
Other Watts More events: 
Build more Watts! (C) 2.5-3.0 W/kg, Tuesday 19.00 CET  
Different Watts! (D) 2.2-2.4 W/kg, Thursday 19.00 CET 
Rendurance! (C) 2.2-2.6 W/kg, Saturday 9.00 AM CET

name: Stage 4 - Tour Fever
description:
Set your alarms—it’s Tour Fever! Ride the Tour de France and Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift your way, with stages inspired by both races. Cruise it, spin it, or turn up the pace—just don’t miss a stage. 

Two iconic races. One global community. Let’s ride.

name: Vikings Valhalla Sunday Skaal ride
description:
Welcome to the Vikings Valhalla Sunday Skaal ride. 

We would love to have you join us to toast a ride together to end the week. Our rides are very inclusive with a ‘’no one gets dropped’’ approach. We encourage riders to respect the leader's pace and ride with the yellow beacon. This is NOT A RACE! Stronger riders are encouraged to fall back and help sweep the riders struggling in the back. If you are looking for a fun ride with lots of Skaal this is the perfect ride for you.

Come and try us..

For more information about our rides go to: https://www.facebook.com/groups/503388660165279/

name: SZR Groupworkouts by Aktivitus
description:
These WOs are designed to give you improved aerobic development and increased aerobic threshold (LT1) -endurance - in a 2h workout. To get most out of this session, make sure your FTP is correct set. If you are aerobic underdeveloped for cycling you may need to decrease your FTP-settings.

The workout is 120min and starts with a 15min warmup. First main block is 3x15min at a controlled threshold/Sweet spot (90% of FTP) on lower cadences to wear us down and to get a time effective local aerobic development and cycling strength (endurance).

The second block contains 20x30/60sek intervals. 30sec at 150% of FTP with a 1min active rest. This is highly anaerobic which gives us an improved lactic tolerance and an increased anaerobic stanima. However, in a worn-out state these intervals will also stress your aerobic development. That means you oxygen transport into your working muscles will get better. Your endurance will thereby increase.

This WO is designed Johan Hasselmark at Aktivitus (www.aktivitus.se). Aktivitus runs Swedens leading test and coaching operations for endurance sports.
Johan Hasselmark is an international level adventure racer and extreme triathlete with several wins, 30 years of competative experince in endurance sports and 8 years of coaching and physiological testing.

name: ZZRC Wacky Chase
description:
Welcome to ZZRC’s Wacky Chase!

Get ready to saddle up for an unforgettable adventure that combines pace, fun, and a dash of friendly competition! Our group rides are open to all riders, and we’ve constructed a delightful two paced category to ensure everyone can enjoy a safe and top-notch experience on two wheels.

Here’s the game plan: we’ve divided our crew into two spirited teams. Team B will zoom at a snappy 3.2-3.8 pace, Team C will enjoy a smooth cruise at 2.4-2.8. We’re throwing in a twist of excitement with a hot chase. Team C takes off first from the pen, followed swiftly by Team B.

This isn’t just another group ride; it’s your ticket to banter, camaraderie, and a good ol’ time! Our leaders will guide you, sharing pacing tips and tricks along the way. Remember, teamwork makes the dream work, so use that draft to your advantage as you barrel through the ride together!

A couple of quick housekeeping notes: we’re keeping the atmosphere all-inclusive and relaxed, with a focus on enjoyment rather than perfection. Sweeps and Ride Buddies will be off-duty this time, so if you find yourself lagging behind, feel free to continue at your own pace or buddy up with fellow riders nearby.

And hey, we’ve got a little rule: leave the TT Bikes at home! They don’t draft well and might make you puff and pant a bit more than you want. Mountain bikes? They’re welcome too, just be prepared to push a little harder than the folks on road bikes. No worries if you hit a snag; our 30-minute late join feature will let you teleport back to the main group with the magical YELLOW BEACON!

We’re all about chatting and having fun while we ride, so don’t miss out on our dedicated Discord channel! Join us, choose your pace, and get ready to share the laughs as we roll.

**Top Tips for Wacky Chase Success:**

1. Stick close to your ride leader; don’t let that gap turn into a canyon!

2. Avoid the fence—we want you in one piece, not fried!

3. Most importantly… HAVE FUN! This is all about the adventure.

Don’t forget to connect with us on our ZZRC Facebook page and join the club on the companion app for all the latest gossip and rides!

So get your cycling gear on, bring your best vibes, and let’s hit the Zwift Roads together!

Discord Channel

https://discord.com/channels/1009379476041383946/1009388181269004289

name: Foudre Sunday Coffee Ride
description:
Sortie dominicale Foudre : Foudre Sunday Coffee Ride

INTRO
La Team Foudre vous propose de venir évacuer les toxines de Mirabelle de la vieille, de passer un moment ensemble pour peaufiner votre endurance, et s'amuser lors des sprints pour les plus valeureux.
Lors de cette sortie plus longue, nous arpenterons des parcours variés et plus longs. Il s’agit d’une sortie de groupe conviviale et non d’une course, n’hésitez pas à venir nous rejoindre sur le canal vocal général sur le Discord.

DETAILS
Durée : 1h30 mais vous pourrez poursuivre et boucler le parcours si vous n’avez encore débloqué le badge du parcours
Join-Late : Activé
Déblocage du maillot Foudre : Oui, à condition d'être toujours dans l'évènement lorsque celui-ci se termine

GROUPES
2 groupes de niveau :
- LEADER (jaune) environ 2,5 w/kg (2,5 à 3,0 dans les montées)
- SWEEPER (rouge) environ 2,2 w/kg. (2,5 à 3,0 dans les montées) »

REGROUPEMENT
Nous essayons après chaque difficulté de faire en sorte que les groupes se reforment autour des leaders.
Rester donc près de votre leader pour éviter d’être distancé et vous retrouver seul. Si vous êtes lâchés, n’hésitez pas à prévenir au plus tôt (sur discord ou par message sur Zwift) pour se regrouper ou trouver d'autres coureurs pour vous regrouper.

Pour profiter au maximum de la sortie, rejoins nous sur le discord Foudre et notamment sur l'audio via l'oreillette : https://discord.gg/YzcVYJY

#TeamFoudre #jerseyunlock

name: Flanders Endurance Race
description:
Prepare your racing and climbing skills for the Flanders Endurance Race League.
This league are open races (held on Sunday) build on stamina. Races will be longer dan 2 hours.
Please note the race is from the gun, including any event 'warm-up' on the lap counter. Categories will all start together.

RACE RULES

No powerups.
No TT bikes.
Heart rate monitors are compulsory for "all" categories.
Power Meter and Smart Trainer winners take category win.
zPower riders will not be included in zwiftpower results

Riders must opt-in to ZwiftPower for official results via their Zwift profile settings @ https://my.zwift.com/profile/connectionsOpens a new window
Riders must register an account @ www.zwiftpower.comOpens a new window and agree to the T&C's to be included in official results.
Riders going over 5w/kg at 95% of 20 minute power will be removed from results.
Riders going over 6w/kg for 5 minute power will be removed from results.
Official results located @ www.zwiftpower.comOpens a new window

It is essential that all participants are honest and select the correct pen/category below which correlates to their current/potential FTP. (Please use your FTP divided by your weight in kg to select the correct category below.) Riders that have at least 3 ZP results (in their race history) on a higher FTP category level than the chosen one will be DQ'd ! If you're in doubt, please contact the organizer for more information.

NOTE : if you have a ZP cat tag lower than your W/kg FTP due to low body weight choose your FTP cat ! Example : Rider with an FTP of 4.5 W/kg but a B tag on ZP because of <250W will race A and not B !
The organizer can DQ riders when in doubt of performance and awaiting the correct info of the rider, the rider has to contact the organizer to discuss this matter.

CATEGORIES

(A) 4.0 W/kg FTP or higher
(B) 3.2 W/kg to 3.99 W/kg FTP
(C) 2.5 W/kg to 3.19 W/kg FTP
(D) Under 2.49 W/kg FTP

BZR homepage : https://www.facebook.com/BelgianZwiftRiders.BZR/Opens a new window

Our BZR stream Channels :
https://www.twitch.tv/tsbikerOpens a new window
https://www.youtube.com/user/TSbiker10Opens a new window
https://www.facebook.com/BZRECYCLINGTVOpens a new window

eventSubgroups.name: Flanders Endurance Race  (D)
eventSubgroups.description:
Prepare your racing and climbing skills for the Flanders Endurance Race League.
This league are open races (held on Sunday) build on stamina. Races will be longer dan 2 hours.
Please note the race is from the gun, including any event 'warm-up' on the lap counter. Categories will all start together.

RACE RULES

No powerups.
No TT bikes.
Heart rate monitors are compulsory for "all" categories.
Power Meter and Smart Trainer winners take category win.
zPower riders will not be included in zwiftpower results

Riders must opt-in to ZwiftPower for official results via their Zwift profile settings @ https://my.zwift.com/profile/connectionsOpens a new window
Riders must register an account @ www.zwiftpower.comOpens a new window and agree to the T&C's to be included in official results.
Riders going over 5w/kg at 95% of 20 minute power will be removed from results.
Riders going over 6w/kg for 5 minute power will be removed from results.
Official results located @ www.zwiftpower.comOpens a new window

It is essential that all participants are honest and select the correct pen/category below which correlates to their current/potential FTP. (Please use your FTP divided by your weight in kg to select the correct category below.) Riders that have at least 3 ZP results (in their race history) on a higher FTP category level than the chosen one will be DQ'd ! If you're in doubt, please contact the organizer for more information.

NOTE : if you have a ZP cat tag lower than your W/kg FTP due to low body weight choose your FTP cat ! Example : Rider with an FTP of 4.5 W/kg but a B tag on ZP because of <250W will race A and not B !
The organizer can DQ riders when in doubt of performance and awaiting the correct info of the rider, the rider has to contact the organizer to discuss this matter.

CATEGORIES

(A) 4.0 W/kg FTP or higher
(B) 3.2 W/kg to 3.99 W/kg FTP
(C) 2.5 W/kg to 3.19 W/kg FTP
(D) Under 2.49 W/kg FTP

name: WELCOME TO THE BRAUNSTEIN CYCLING CLUB DANISH GROUP RIDE
description:
This is a social group workout; a chance every week for members to get together from around the globe, ride, chat and support each other - it’s run as a group workout session with ‘keep everyone together’ enabled so no matter what your pace you’ll stay in the pack - it’s not a race or competition and open for anyone to join us.

WHO IS THE BCC?

The BRAUNSTEIN Cycling Club (BCC) is, as the name suggests, Braunstein brewery’s Cycling Club. The BCC is a danish social Cycling club were we share our passion for Cycling.

For more information head to: www.braunstein.dk/bcc2

RIDE LEADERS

The rides are led by our friendly team of member ride leaders. The Leader (who has a yellow beacon over their head) will ride at a steady pace as set by the workout session. On most occasions we will have a support ride leader (who will also have a beacon), the ride leaders are there to help support you and keep the banter going - to join the chat use the Zwift Companion smartphone app.

Map/Route — Wattopia
Distance/Time/Laps — 1 hour
Type of Event - Group Ride
ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.

name: Zwift Riders Scotland Sunday Club Ride
description:
Scottish people are mad about cycling and keen to provide exciting and fun rides.
Please see our ride descriptions below to give you options to join us.

eventSubgroups.name: Zwift Riders Scotland Sunday Club Ride (C)
eventSubgroups.description:
In Scottish summer we might not have leaders available for this ride. Pls try to ride at the Cat descriptions anyway. Come join some daft Scottish people passionate about Zwift cycling. We ride for an hour every Sunday morning on our weekly social Club ride. Often to exercise, sometimes just to sober up. We ride in various group. This is group C.

Although this is not really a race, it will in true Zwift tradition maybe get a bit spicy. This ride is not always led by members or our club, so we encourage anyone to join and test each other out with the average power numbers set for the group. 

When in place a leader and sweeper will try to keep the group together matching the reasonable effort at the front and encouraging others to help the sweeper with those at the back. We might do some wee tests or sprints or little races to the lamppost if we/you feel like it. Please chat via messaging, but we have a discord channel for you to use for the banter if you want. If for some reason you can’t make the start time, late joining is available up to 30mins post. 

Please use our "Sunday Club Ride" Discord voice channel here:  https://discord.com/channels/731107240987197461/1329849513313042463

eventSubgroups.name: Zwift Riders Scotland Sunday Club Ride (D)
eventSubgroups.description:
In Scottish summer we might not have leaders available for this ride. Pls try to ride at the Cat descriptions anyway. Come join some daft Scottish people passionate about Zwift cycling. We ride for an hour every Sunday morning on our weekly social Club ride. Often to exercise, sometimes just to sober up. We ride in various group. This is group D.

It’s a group ride so it’s not a race.  All abilities are welcome, but we’ll be tootling along at between 1.5 to 2.2. That’s where the banners will be but if you fancy shooting ahead on the day you are very welcome. You might miss the craic, but you won’t get removed. We might do some wee tests or sprints or little races to the lamppost if we/you feel like it. If you’re way ahead by then you might miss something fun. 

The leader and sweeper will try to keep the group together matching the reasonable effort at the front and encouraging others to help the sweeper with those at the back. We will chat via messaging, but we have a discord channel for you to use for the banter if you want. If for some reason you can’t make the start time, late joining is available up to 30mins post. 

Please use our "Sunday Club Ride" Discord voice channel here: https://discord.com/channels/731107240987197461/1329850433962770657

eventSubgroups.name: Zwift Riders Scotland Sunday Club Ride (E)
eventSubgroups.description:
In Scottish summer we might not have leaders available for this ride. Pls try to ride at the Cat descriptions anyway. Come join some daft Scottish people passionate about Zwift cycling. We ride for an
hour every Sunday morning on our weekly social Club ride - often to exercise,
sometimes just to sober up. 

Group E is a very steady group ride, no way is it a race.  We’re here to encourage
beginners and recovering riders to come ride in a group. We’ll be going at between
1.0 and 1.5 watts/kilo, it’s no drop. 

The Lead and Sweep banners will riding around these power levels but if you want to go on ahead you are welcome, you might miss the chat and the socialising.  You won’t get removed by riding through the red fence of doom. We might add in some sprints or hill climbs but we will try to re-establish the blob when these are over.  If you fall behind, the sweep or helper will try to drop back to offer a wheel with the intention of trying to help you rejoin the main group or just to keep you company if that’s what you want.

The leader and sweeper will try to keep the group together matching the reasonable
effort at the front and encouraging others to help the sweeper with those at the back.

Please use our "Sunday Club Ride" Discord voice channel here https://discord.com/channels/731107240987197461/1329849787687764079

🧭 Ride leads manage pacing and communication. Sweepers check in with riders and help regroup when needed.

🔒Warm-up around 1.5 w/kg, then settle into 1.8–2.2 w/kg. Fence is on to keep the group together and may be lifted during sprints and towards the end.

name: ZZRC Bring a Bidon Social Ride
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Bring a Bidon 2.4-2.7. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2.4-2.7 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicate a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us
on Discord: https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: The Cortado
description:
Welcome to The Cortado! A Cortado is a delicious coffee drink with equal parts milk and espresso. For our ride this means you get both a relaxed group ride (the milk) and a race at the end (the espresso)!
This ride is fence enabled to keep riders together and the group will move at 2.8-3.5w/kg, keeping the group together until ~10 miles are left in the ride when the espresso race begins.
The Cortado is all about camaraderie, banter, and ripping each others' legs off at the end! Join our Discord server to chat via text or voice if desired!
Give your course suggestions to us at @saris.nopinz on Instagram!

name: FRR Weekend Warrior Series - SCRATCH
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our WEEKEND WARRIOR which build on the Classica races and the full series to mid August.

Each event will offer 3 races Friday to Sunday, using three formats - iTT / Scratch / Points - each race will convert to points, based on segments and finish - a riders points total will be drawn from all 3 races, do more, score more!

Each event will center around the type of course and terrain of the monument, with the actual race day event being of a length that is fitting for the monument.

Classica races are part of the FRR Weekend Warrior Race Series for which there will be at least 10 WW events, refer to website for the Schedule and rules:

Series Schedule
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-schedule/

Rules
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-rules

Event Basics
- Public events - MIXED RACING
- Five Max 30day ZRS ranged pens
- Mandatory racing experience - HRM - Smart Trainers


- Season long Order of Merit (OoM)
- Best 7 scoring events to count (an event counts the points from all 3 races over

FRR Registered riders form the OoM - Top 10 earn prizes on condition they are FRR Subscribers 

For all details, registration and how to become an FRR subscriber vist our website:
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD

Discord - RACE channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the series

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers - HRM
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform 
- HRMs are mandatory

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

name: DIRT The Merge powered by Formula 369
description:
Welcome to endurance central, it’s time to take your riding to the next level. The Merge powered by Formula 369 is a true endurance long ride. The group is looking to keep steady power pacing and work together to keep pressure on the pedals while we enjoy friendly DIRT chat and social nature. All are welcome, no discrimination, and friendly.

This is NOT a race chase. The D group departs first, then C, and finally B, all riding at advertised pace. This will NATURALLY create a merge/meeting of groups. When groups meet, riders choose to stay with their group and leader or merge with the faster group. Similarly, faster group riders can stay with the slower group. Riders choice.

The group leaders help maintain group cohesion, listen up for their guidance.

A couple other notes:

-30 min late join.

-Sweeps will be organized as needed.

-Climb pace will be announced by the group leader and is designed to keep the group stay together. If you want to work harder, then pull the group on the flats. The group leader and group will NOT chase those doing more than the decided climb pace.

-This ride is designed to keep you in a narrow power band, for true endurance training. This ride is NOT about climbing hard and sitting in on flats and downs.

-Being a nice human is always first priority.

-Those who train together become family. This family works together, supports each other, and cares about each other.

-Those planning to ride an average in the middle of the groups are encouraged to pick a group and stay on pace. Both groups can be pulled on the flats but spreading the group out on climbs or false flats is not appreciated. Those riding 3-3.4 can practice drafting skills with B group.

name: CRYO-GEN TSS: The Sunday Session
description:
Kick off your Sunday with a purposeful, two-hour structured burn. The Sunday Session (TSS) is designed for the rider looking to build a massive aerobic engine. We aren’t here to sprint or chase jerseys; we’re here to do the work that makes you an endurance powerhouse on the road.

The Mission
This session focuses on aerobic conditioning. By maintaining a steady and controlled output for 120 minutes or more, we trigger the adaptations necessary to improve our endurance, durability, and fatigue resistance.

The Workout Structure
This is a banded group workout. As long as you keep pedaling, the "rubber band" effect will keep us together regardless of your power output. This event utilizes ERG mode, so your trainer will automatically adjust resistance to hit the target power for each interval. Intervals may feel challenging, even exceeding your estimated functional threshold power (FTP). CRYO-GEN TSS is open to riders of all levels. Embrace the challenge and push yourself to complete the session at the specified power. Your effort will pay off!

Join the Conversation
Use the Zwift Companion App or your keyboard to chat with the group. Share your goals for the upcoming week, discuss your favorite ride snacks, or just enjoy the scenery as we clock hours in the saddle together. See you on the virtual road!

name: FRR Sunday Drive
description:
"Flamme Rouge Racing Sunday Drive - is this a race ... if you want but equally group up and enjoy the burn.... Different route each week, 90mins to 2hrs

Ride leads may vary each week and when the Tours are on Race Control will certainly be racing... but enjoy them after all it's your time...

If you fancy the hardest but most rewarding Tour on Zwift with great support then come register at 
https://www.flammerougeracing.com/?page=home

Tour of France (21 – 29th October) - Completed
Tour Britannia (25th November - 3 December) - 8 Stages in 9 days
Tour Watopia (2nd – 10th January) - 8 Stages in 9 days
World Tour (17 Feb - 10 March) - 21 Stages 3 weeks full Tour length
World Championship - Apil 12 - 1 Stage 1 time globally

The event Incorporates a mixture of flat, hilly and mountain courses, increasing the intensity as the Tour progresses using a mix of iTT and POINTS races.

EVENT PENs are via autocat and will release at the same time
All riders will see and be able to communicate to each other in race - separatign the most powerful riders is expected to provide more appropriate race starts for every class of rider

Communication

Discord - Tour channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything on the Tour

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Facebook FRR Event Group - A place where we share intentions and thought for community input before we do stuff

So be SMART and use SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anythung more will be removed and warnings will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

description:
Please join us weekly on Sunday mornings for a 2 hour endurance group ride. 

C cat pace 2.5 - 3.0 w/kg  

Our yellow beacon will ride steady in C cat at 2.5-3.0 w/kg and in D cat at 1.5-2.0 w/kg for the entirety of the ride. On the hills we will not exceed the upper end of these ranges.

name: 6Points Challenges Group Sunday Training Ride
description:
This is a TRAINING event, category C, with a yellow beacon leader. The beacon leader will ride up to a 2.5w/kg pace average wherever possible. The beacon may employ the fence at times.

Please look out for this training ride on Sundays, every week, at 11.40am UTC in the UK, 6.40am EDT in the US, and at 12.40 CET in Europe. Use #6Points to search for our rides on the Zwift website.

This weekly 6Points Mallorca Sunday training ride is intended to provide a challenge for riders, and is open to all timezones. You should ride as a group, following the instructions of the beacon ride leader(s) for any sprints, intervals and spicy segments, regrouping after each when requested. All our group rides also have a closing minirace, to start from behind the beacon. The fence may be used to control starts for these spicy sections. About the in-real-life Reverence 6Points Mallorca
The ultra-distance Reverence 6Points Mallorca real life cycling event, with Title sponsor Reverence Hotels, is ridden around Mallorca and raises money for charity, currently supporting Asdica, who work on behalf of disabled children, and Save-the-Med. Now in its third edition, it has already earned a reputation as a fun but tough event that epitomises cycling at its best. 6Points has raised over €100,000 for charities in this way over three years.

6Points is a ride around the whole of the beautiful island of Mallorca, covering well over 420 kms, climbing 7500 metres and touching the four compass extremities, as well as the highest and lowest points of Mallorca, over 3 days. See https://6pointschallenges.com/ for more about our in-real-life events. We also run these events in Ibiza / Formentera and Menorca.

Like our Zwift group ride, 6Points Mallorca is NOT a race. It is an opportunity to participate in a challenging ride, with like-minded cyclists, to enjoy Mallorca’s diverse beauty and the friendship and camaraderie of fellow riders. 6Points supports sustainable cycling, whose riders care for the environment and practise courtesy to fellow road users.

We have organized our 6Points Zwift training ride series to suit what we believe is relevant to bike riders’ interests in performance and improvement, bearing in mind the in-real-life 6Points Mallorca challenge which is also ridden in groups with controlled pace.

The 6Points Zwift group ride
As we expect our riders to be able to ride up to 100 miles at or around a 15mph average on our irl (in-real-life) rides, such steady riding members should be comfortable with Zwift Category C. Beacon leaders communicate via Zwift message (always) and/or Discord (sometimes) to vary the pace to allow for sprints, intervals and optionally a mini-race towards the end of the rides, with regrouping after each sprint. Make as much use of drafting as you can, for more effective sprinting and rest intervals.

During the ride, the beacon will announce any sprints, and the ride will finish with a minirace to the end of the ride of between 3kms and 8kms depending on the course. The Beacon will announce this too.

Results (the finishing order, relevant to the minirace which we will all start together) can be seen at the end of the ride on screen, and we will, in common with many other ride series, publish your results on zwiftpower.com too, based on the ride category C.

All bikes and Power-Ups (PU) are allowed, but it is better not to use TT bikes to ensure drafting. Please add 6Points (X) to your Zwift name to allow your ride presence to be recognized, where X is your own ride category. Categories in Zwift are related to your Functional Threshold Power (FTP); use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg to get the W/kg that applies to you.

On this ride series, all riders and categories are welcome, but bear in mind that rides are designed for:

Category C: 2 W/kg to 3 W/kg FTP. The beacon leader will ride to 2.5w/kg pace average or below.

PLEASE NOTE: Strava data for our rides must be open (not private or hidden). Please use a heart rate monitor so that we can monitor correlated power and heart rate to help assure fair riding.

You can use our Discord channel to talk to each other at https://discord.gg/bPsQCNh

Please see the 6Points Zwift page link at https://6pointschallenges.com for more, including how we support our chosen charities.

https://6pointschallenges.com/

#6points

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

name: NonSequitur Social Splash
description:
Welcome to the NonSequitur Social Splash! A banded ride for the absolute beginner,
the recovering injured or any Zwifter looking for a relaxing beginner ride that hits the
sweet spot of off beat & entertaining then this is the ride for you. What will you find on
this ride you ask...bad jokes, typos, riding tips, encouragement but most importantly a
place to build your abilities and confidence.

name: ZZRC Wind Down Sub 2
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Wind Down Sub 2. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.7-1.9 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be sub 2 .

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .

We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel for our sub 2
https://discord.gg/RJ3dhbjCEp

TOP TIPS
1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!
2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone
3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: ZLDR WARMUP-10km
description:

It doesn’t matter how far, it doesn’t matter how fast. Just come along, be active and get involved with a really great group.

Use this event however you want, top up your mileage for the week, recovery run, workouts, Walk/Run Intervals or use it for PB bashing (and get the best support squad around cheering you on) or come along for a natter with other members. Just be comfortable to use this event to do whatever activity you want and go however far.

A good chat and a laugh at the same time, and being able to do this with people all around the world and make friendships through Zwift and ZLDR is awesome.

Please join us for the ZLDR WARMUP and come have some fun.

ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. We are here to support your running dreams and help you develop your running skills. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners and walkers who want to help you set and achieve new goals!

name: ODZentury Endurance Builder Ride
description:
Come join Team ODZ every Sunday morning for an Endurance Skill building ride.

Emphasis will be on teamwork and building endurance fitness as a group throughout the winter.

The ride will offer two pace categories (B & C) and will be marshaled by a yellow beacon.

name: LGBTQz Ride with Pride
description:
Everyone is welcome to join LGBTQ Zwifters and friends as we Ride with Pride all
year round in our Sunday social ride.
Our social ride is all about togetherness and most rides will use the rubberband so
we can be one big, joyful bunch cruising the roads where everyone belongs. No
surges, no stress, no getting left behind.
If the leader isn’t using the rubberband, they will let you know, but they’ll aim to
maintain a social pace. You can check the event details to see if this is the case for
this ride by using the link 'Toggle Event Details' at the end of the event description on
zwift.com.
Ride leaders may have quizzes or other fun stuff planned for you, so please do get
involved using the companion app chat function.
Our rides are inclusive, we value diversity and courage, and we are always
respectful. Ride chat may involve LGBTQIA+ topics so please come with an open
heart and open mind. If you want to enjoy a relaxed ride with an amazing community,
this is your space. Ride proud, ride together, and let’s make the miles brighter.
If you want to learn more about what to expect on one of our rides, or find links to our
Club and socials, please visit: https://lgbtq-zwifters.com/

name: Into the Red Race by RELENTLESS
description:
Into the Red Race by RELENTLESS

WHAT IS CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT?
Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for. Our goal is to increase fairness in racing while promoting a fun environment.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
The race will be mass start and allow all racers to push themselves to the next level.  Each race will change routes and worlds each week but will always be 25 km.  These “different” race finishes will require tactics and planning to know when and where to play your move.

You must be opted-in on Zwift.com & ZwiftPower.com to be counted for race results.
We highly encourage A racers to follow Zwift eRacing Ruleset.

Dual recording of trainer & power meter, and recent weigh-in based on Zwift Transparency rules recommended–we reserve the right to ask for this information to verify outstanding performances.

name: The HERD Sunday Endurance
description:
Welcome to the Herd’s Sunday Endurance Ride.

This is not a race, but a long ride at a steady pace with a big group. We ride together for two hours at a pace of 1.5 w/kg on the flats and 2.0 w/kg on climbs.

All riders are welcome and appreciated. Whether you’re brand-new to Zwift or have been on the platform for a decade, we want to ride with you.

Routes change weekly and we ask that you please follow the ride leader’s instructions. The ride leader can turn on the fence if needed to control the pace, but we are always better working as a team. Please respect the leader's pace and stay with the yellow beacon.

Stronger riders are encouraged to fall back and help sweep the riders struggling in the back, rather than flying off the front. And if you fall off the pace give a shout and someone will fall back to help bring you back to the group.

Check us out on:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerd/Strava:

name: HerD Beginner Races
description:
Where do you go to try racing or to grow a little better with your racing craft… Herd Beginner Races is set up to provide you with that opportunity by using Zwift Racing Scores (ZRS) with bandwidths that are set up so you’re competing with people of similarities and routes that enable you to challenge yourself and grow with racing. Our pens are set up so you're racing with others of similar abilities. Zwift will recommend your pen in blue; you can race in a higher up pen but it's not recommended.

Each week HBR races will have a different focus; racing on a flat route, rolling/undulating with a small climbs, and a route that is commonly used in many Zwift racing events. In addition, the last race of the month will be Tick-Tock so that you can monitor your performance.

name: DIRT XLR Xtra Long Ride
description:
Please join us weekly on Sunday mornings for a 2 hour endurance group ride. 

Two groups:
C cat pace 2.5 - 3.0 w/kg  
D cat pace 1.5 - 2.0 w/kg. 

Our yellow beacon will ride steady in C cat at 2.5-3.0 w/kg and in D cat at 1.5-2.0 w/kg for the entirety of the ride. On the hills we will not exceed the upper end of these ranges.

name: Ascend Together - A Zwift Climbing Adventure
description:
Join forces with Ascenders and Mountain Massif Club for a weekly tradition: Ascend Together. Each week, we’ll tackle a fresh climbing challenge on Zwift, rotating routes to keep the adventure alive and spirits high. Some weeks, we'll even target special Route Badges — perfect for those climbs that seem a little too daunting when tackled solo.

This ride is open to everyone in the Zwift community because, frankly, we love your company. Expect a steady pace around 2.5 w/kg, designed to keep the group together and the energy strong. Fellow Zwift Clubs are warmly invited to co-lead and/or ride alongside us — after all, this is a celebration of everything we love about Zwift: the rides, the climbs, the camaraderie, the positivity and the community.

No matter your club, team, or solo status, we welcome you to make Ascend Together part of your weekly schedule. Let’s create a ride to remember — every single week. See you on the climb!
