name: RO4H Sunday Social Spin
description:
Welcome to the RO4H Sunday Social Spin!
The RO4H Sunday Social Spin is a friendly, supportive group ride hosted by the Ride On 4 Health community. We aim to create a casual, respectful atmosphere that welcomes everyone—from seasoned Zwifters to first‑time group ride participants.
Pace & Expectations
Our overall average pace is typically 18–20 MPH (28–32 KPH). Terrain will naturally influence speed:
- Flats may run slightly faster within the peloton
- Climbs will remain sub‑2 W/kg
- Routes are usually flat, and we strive to be a no‑drop ride
This pace is recovery for some and a solid effort for others, so riders should be prepared to meet the average and stay with the leader’s peloton to enjoy the draft. This is a social ride, not a race—we don’t chase flyers, and flyers are free to fly.
Sweep Support
Sweepers are on hand to help anyone who drifts off the back. Their goal is to ensure no one rides alone unless they prefer to. They may help riders bridge back to the peloton or form a second pace group for a more comfortable experience.
Join the Fun
Come along for the RO4H Sunday Social Spin—you’ll likely break a sweat, hear a few dad jokes, and definitely have some fun. Welcome to the RO4H family!

eventSubgroups.name: RO4H Sunday Social Spin (D)
eventSubgroups.description:
Welcome to the RO4H Sunday Social Spin. 

The RO4H Sunday Social Spin is a social group ride hosted by the Ride On 4 Health community where a friendly, casual, supportive, and respectful atmosphere embraces everyone from the most seasoned Zwifter to the first-time group ride participant.   

The pace varies depending on terrain but will have an overall average pace of about 18-20 MPH/28-32 KPH for the ride. The pace on the flats sections will be slightly faster in the peloton and will remain sub 2 W/KG on climbs. We typically ride flat routes and try to be a no-drop ride but ultimately this pace is a recovery pace for some and a great effort for others. You should be prepared to meet the average pace and strive to stay in the ride leaders peloton to benefit from the group draft effect.  Being a social ride, we don’t chase flyers — flyers are free to fly — and this ride is certainly not a race (#zwiftisalwaysarace). 

Sweepers are available to assist those off the back. We do not want anyone to ride alone unless they choose. The sweepers will variably help riders bridge to the peloton or form a second pace group so riders do not ride alone.  

So come along for the RO4H Social Spin — you'll almost certainly break a sweat, undoubtedly hear a few dad jokes, and might even have some fun.

The pace of the lead group (Category A) will be determined by the leader for that week. If you can't stay with the lead group, please join others riding at a more preferred pace. If you keep doing these events the climbing will get easier (Well that's the plan).

description:
The race is on. Tour Fever brings the Tour de France and Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift together—now it’s your turn to race them. Full gas from the start, hold the wheel, and bring it to the line. Every stage counts.

name: The Zwifty Fifty with DZR
description:
**The Zwifty Fifty: When 25 is Too Little and 100 is Too Much**

DZR brings to you the Goldilocks of Zwift racing intensity and endurance balance. With weekly races at about 50 km, the races are not too short and intensive to build stamina, and not too long and time-consuming to actually get done. They are just right. And they are on every Sunday at 14:45 CET | 8:45 AM EST.

To add to the fun and keep a high intensity throughout the race, we have included bonus second sprints. These sprints are on flats when the finish is on a KOM and on KOMs when the finish is flat.

No powerups, no zpower, no TT bikes, HRM enforced.

For all the details, including stage information, bonus sprints, rules, and registration links, visit the official website for The Zwifty Fifty at http://dzrracingseries.com/the-zwifty-fifty/

name: WOW - High Speed Ride on TT bikes with draft
description:
The WOW Zwift events are the fastest way to collect happy miles while meeting exceptional riders/ friends on ZWIFT. While you will be assigned a fast TT bike with the latest DT Swiss Disc wheel set in draft mode, you will still be upgrading your bike of choice selected in your garage before starting the ride.

Our Ds (Development of ‘Drecovery’ 😊) leave the pen first and hold the group together within D power limits. Several minutes later C’s (Crusaders) will start and keep riding as one unit guided by the power range. Further several minutes later the B train (Bombers) starts unleashing their watts. Several minutes later the A magician group (Aliens) take off and rapidly make up the delays from the groups starting ahead. When will the groups catch each other? Every catch will be an opportunity to celebrate the ONE WOW FAMILY!

All groups will see each other, transfers between the groups on the go will be possible. The ride leaders will help make those transitions smooth.

WOW is a no drama, full fun ride!

Double draft is on and the fast TT bikes will be drafting!

name: FRR Weekend Warrior Series - SCRATCH
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our WEEKEND WARRIOR which build on the Classica races and the full series to mid August.

Each event will offer 3 races Friday to Sunday, using three formats - iTT / Scratch / Points - each race will convert to points, based on segments and finish - a riders points total will be drawn from all 3 races, do more, score more!

Each event will center around the type of course and terrain of the monument, with the actual race day event being of a length that is fitting for the monument.

Classica races are part of the FRR Weekend Warrior Race Series for which there will be at least 10 WW events, refer to website for the Schedule and rules:

Series Schedule
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-schedule/

Rules
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-rules

Event Basics
- Public events - MIXED RACING
- Five Max 30day ZRS ranged pens
- Mandatory racing experience - HRM - Smart Trainers


- Season long Order of Merit (OoM)
- Best 7 scoring events to count (an event counts the points from all 3 races over

FRR Registered riders form the OoM - Top 10 earn prizes on condition they are FRR Subscribers 

For all details, registration and how to become an FRR subscriber vist our website:
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD

Discord - RACE channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the series

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers - HRM
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform 
- HRMs are mandatory

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.

description:
Set your alarms—it’s Tour Fever! Ride the Tour de France and Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift your way, with stages inspired by both races. Cruise it, spin it, or turn up the pace—just don’t miss a stage. 

Two iconic races. One global community. Let’s ride.

name: Bike MS - Banded Badge Hunt
description:
Multiple Sclerosis does not stop, so neither will we as we ride together for this great cause. Bike MS is excited to offer another series of rides to keep cyclists connected year round with hopes of also connecting at one of the many Bike MS Events across the US in person. The Rubberband effect will be on during the ride to help keep cyclists of all abilities together as we explore some of the longer and more difficult routes throughout the many worlds of Zwift. 
Whatever pace you ride we welcome you to come join a group of passionate cyclists looking to raise funds and awareness for those living with multiple sclerosis. We hope you enjoy the ride and if so, please join Bike MS Zwift Club for year round training and community engagement. Come for the miles of smiles and stay for the XP. 
Bike MS is the largest charity cycling series across the United States consisting of 50 rides and raising over $50 million in 2023 for the National MS Society. Bike MS supports the National MS Society's mission to Cure MS while empowering all people affected by MS to live their best lives. Whether you want to cross the Finish Line in person or take on a new challenge from anywhere — there’s a Bike MS event that’s right for you! 
Check out www.bikeMS.org and experience the ride of your life. Use Zwift25 for a discount on your Bike MS Ride entry fee.
Come join us for weekly Club Rides: Bike MS ZC
#dontjustride #bikeMS #whateverittakes #strongertogether

name: ZZRC Sunday Cruise Control
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Cruise Control 2-2.5. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2-2.5 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised.

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .

We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel
https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX

TOP TIPS
1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!
2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone
3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app.

description:
Tronathon is a social, supportive banded ride. We help riders build strength, endurance and comfort in riding hills. We also mix in a healthy amount of entertainment and distraction. All are welcome whether you are a newer cyclist, question if you can reach the summit of one of Zwift's hills, currently hate climbing, or just want to support other riders. Everyone has a story about their first Alpe, Tron quest or the climbing gains they've made and we want to hear yours. We are a fun loving community and welcome all who might want to join us!

name: Catrina's Ladies Social Ride
description:
I would like to invite ALL women to join this Social Ride & Social exchange! Our goals during the ride are as follows:

1. Recovery from Training
2. Socialization with other women riders (via Catrina’s Social Ride channel or Group Texting in Zwift)
3. Support, Development, & Growth toward becoming better cyclists/athletes in a nurturing group setting
4. Teaching skills in the Zwift program course (Riding in Groups, Draft Effect, Racing Technique, Rolling Cadence, etc.)
5. To have FUN!

This is a Social Ride, with a goal of keeping everyone together, in order to build on group riding skills. This ride is not a "race", although we may practice racing techniques. At all times, we will try to have 1-2 Ladies on the ride to assist the women on the course. Some weeks will be in workout mode but always at z2 efforts. If you yearn for opportunities to meet & socialize with other women cyclists who are passionate about riding, we strongly encourage you to join us!

Ultimately our goal is to enhance your riding experience, while having FUN!

name: 3R Endurance Steady Ride
description:
3R Chase Endurance Ride

Join us for an exhilarating 3R Group Ride Event, where teamwork isn’t just encouraged, it’s essential!

This description does not include the C endurance ride, this is as usual a normal C endurance ride.

In this Chase Endurance Ride, we embark on a 100km journey, following the same course as our Steady State B group. The aim? To gradually close the gap and merge with the Steady State B Group around the 80km mark, setting the stage for an exciting final stretch.

This ride is about group effort and shared responsibility. We expect each rider to contribute, taking turns on the front with pulls of approximately 4.5-5.0 w/kg. Remember, it’s a chase, not a free ride, so we kindly ask that you join in the spirit of collective effort rather than just drafting throughout.

When our group catches up with the Steady State B group, it’s a chance to mix things up! If you’re feeling strong, keep up the pace with the A group. Alternatively, if you’re in the mood for a more relaxed ride, feel free to settle in with the B group.

Remember, this isn’t a race, but a part of our #ProStyleTraining series, designed to support your training goals in a fun, social setting. We love a bit of friendly banter and encourage you to share your experiences and feedback on our Facebook page at https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/. Let’s ride, raise, race and enjoy together with #Team3R.

name: The Mountain Massif
description:
Every great race has a defining climb.

This event is built for riders who thrive when the road tilts skyward. Expect a demanding route featuring sustained ascents, decisive hills, and relentless terrain that rewards patience, tactical awareness, and exceptional endurance.

The strongest rider doesn’t always win—but the smartest one often does.

Conserve your energy in the wheels. Read the race. Cover the moves that matter. Then, when the gradient bites and your rivals begin to fade, commit without hesitation.

The decisive attack will come. The question is whether you’ll be the one launching it—or chasing it.

There are no easy kilometres here. Every climb is an opportunity to gain time. Every descent is a chance to recover. Every decision shapes the final result.

When the summit is in sight, hesitation is the difference between victory and watching the podium ride away.

Race with discipline. Climb with conviction. Finish with nothing left to give.

Rules:
Heart Rate monitor required and Zwift Power for official results.

More information:
For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram @mountain_massif, Facebook @mountainmassif and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home

name: RO4H Rookie Group Ride
description: Welcome to the RO4H Rookie Group Ride! This event is a relaxed, supportive teaching ride designed to help Zwifters of all experience levels learn the basics of Zwifting and group riding in a friendly, judgment-free environment. We aim for an average pace of 16–19 mph (26–30 kph) in the leader's peloton. Routes are mostly flat, though rolling terrain may cause natural pace changes. Sweepers are available to help riders reconnect or ride comfortably at their own pace. If you're new to group rides or unsure about cycling terms, don't worry—you're in the right place. Many riders here are beginners, and no one is judging. Just click the orange square with the white plus sign and join us. Rookie Tip: We recommend using the Zwift Companion App for communication, navigation, and situational awareness. You can find it at: https://www.zwift.com/companion. Join the RO4H Rookie Ride, learn, ride, and have fun!

name: LGBTQz Ride with Pride
description:
Everyone is welcome to join LGBTQ Zwifters and friends as we Ride with Pride all
year round in our Sunday social ride.
Our social ride is all about togetherness and most rides will use the rubberband so
we can be one big, joyful bunch cruising the roads where everyone belongs. No
surges, no stress, no getting left behind.
If the leader isn’t using the rubberband, they will let you know, but they’ll aim to
maintain a social pace. You can check the event details to see if this is the case for
this ride by using the link 'Toggle Event Details' at the end of the event description on
zwift.com.
Ride leaders may have quizzes or other fun stuff planned for you, so please do get
involved using the companion app chat function.
Our rides are inclusive, we value diversity and courage, and we are always
respectful. Ride chat may involve LGBTQIA+ topics so please come with an open
heart and open mind. If you want to enjoy a relaxed ride with an amazing community,
this is your space. Ride proud, ride together, and let’s make the miles brighter.
If you want to learn more about what to expect on one of our rides, or find links to our
Club and socials, please visit: https://lgbtq-zwifters.com/

name: Herd Summer Racing League
description:
Welcome to the Herd Summer Racing League (HSRL)

HSRL is a series of points races. The race format can be a little bit different week to week, but in most of the races you score points for your time on each of the segments (FTS), versus the times set by the other competitors. You also score bonus points for your finishing position in the race versus your competitors in your category. Each week the race format, segments and points for this race will be posted at the Herd Racing League facebook group and on the Herd Racing discord channel. 

General Classification
The points in each race are used to determine your ranking for the race. Your race rank determines how many league points you receive, with the winner scoring 50 points, 2nd place getting 49 and so on, down to 1 point for 50th place. Each week there are six different events to choose from - choose whichever suits your schedule best.

Schedule
26-28 June: Bologna TT (1 lap, 8.0km) - ITT
3-5 July: Peaky Pave (1 lap, 30.8km) - Points race FTS + FIN
10-12 July: Toefield Tornado (3 laps, 30.6km) - Points race FTS + FIN
17-19 July: Royal Pump Room 8 (1 lap, 27.5km) - Scratch race
24-26 July: 2018 Worlds Short Lap (1 lap, 23.8km) - Points race FTS + FIN
31 July-2 August: Cobbled Crown (1 lap, 24.3km) - Points race FTS + FIN
7-9 August: The Bell Lap (12 laps, 24.0km) - Points race FAL + FIN
14-16 August: Paris finale, course TBA - Points race FTS + FIN

Race rules:
Steering is disabled
Smarttrainer or powermeter required.
Cadence sensor required.
Heart rate monitor required.
No indoor bikes without controlled resistance (cadence=power).
Participants must be registered on zwiftpower.com to be included in the results.
For elite level performances the race organiser can request additional data to verify the performance.
For podium finishers in all categories: Zwift activities must be saved PUBLIC for verification.

For more information please see our Facebook Group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerdRacing

name: Invictus Games Foundation Sunday Social
description:
Hosted by the Invictus Games Foundation. Below the link to the sign up for the event:

https://reg.resport.io/s/step1.jsp?r=4747885851705344

Join our social ride led by members of the Invictus Games international community of serving military personnel and veterans who use cycling to recover from injury.

A sub-2.0 w/kg (Cat D) weekly group ride with the goal of keeping the group together. This event is open to any ability including those who use handcycles, recumbents, trikes, tandems and standard bikes.

Follow the ride leader's instructions and stay as close to the beacon as possible. If you're feeling strong, please use your abilities to help pull fellow riders back to the pack.

There will be inspirational chat and a fun, social atmosphere for your training. Please ask questions - about using sport for recovery, training, set-up and the experiences of our Invictus family.

Late joiners allowed.

name: FRR Weekend Warrior Series - SCRATCH
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our WEEKEND WARRIOR which build on the Classica races and the full series to mid August.

Each event will offer 3 races Friday to Sunday, using three formats - iTT / Scratch / Points - each race will convert to points, based on segments and finish - a riders points total will be drawn from all 3 races, do more, score more!

Each event will center around the type of course and terrain of the monument, with the actual race day event being of a length that is fitting for the monument.

Classica races are part of the FRR Weekend Warrior Race Series for which there will be at least 10 WW events, refer to website for the Schedule and rules:

Series Schedule
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-schedule/

Rules
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-rules

Event Basics
- Public events - MIXED RACING
- Five Max 30day ZRS ranged pens
- Mandatory racing experience - HRM - Smart Trainers


- Season long Order of Merit (OoM)
- Best 7 scoring events to count (an event counts the points from all 3 races over

FRR Registered riders form the OoM - Top 10 earn prizes on condition they are FRR Subscribers 

For all details, registration and how to become an FRR subscriber vist our website:
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD

Discord - RACE channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the series

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers - HRM
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform 
- HRMs are mandatory

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

description:

Please use ZwiftPower's Minimum Category on your profile for race entry.

name: Seattle Baby Steps 1.0-1.3 w/kg
description:
Are you looking for a supportive beginner or recovery ride?  If so welcome to Seattle Baby Steps! This weekly ride will be paced at an average of 1.0-1.3 w/kg on the flats and is intended for riders who are newer, younger, older, and recovering from injuries.  This is an enjoyable and conversational social ride where your participation is encouraged.  Baby Steps' goal is to help you build strength and confidence to try the hundreds of advanced rides, races, and events that are available every week on Zwift.

We haven't jumped on to the Discord bandwagon yet but join us on our Facebook page at: Seattle Baby Steps - Weekly Zwift Group Ride to stay in touch with the group and to share your thoughts and ask Zwift and other cycling-related questions. https://www.facebook.com/search/top/?q=seattle%20baby%20steps%20-%20weekly%20zwift%20group%20ride

GROUP RIDE ETIQUETTE FOR NEWCOMERS

Please respect the ride leader's pace and instructions. This is not a race and the ride leader will not chase anyone riding off the front of the group. If you feel the need to stretch your legs, do so on the sprints and then prepare to regroup immediately afterward. Faster riders are encouraged to sweep in the back to assist less strong riders who may be struggling to rejoin the group after sprints and inclines. Sprinkle Ride Ons far and wide to encourage and delight your fellow riders! Join in on the conversation (on-screen text), but be mindful of the younger folks (i.e., children) who join the ride from time to time.

name: OTR Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time
description:
Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time is a group ride, race & interval training all rolled into one fun challenging event. Unique “race” scoring, where results in ZwiftPower are based on sum of segment times on a route with punchy climbs and/or sprints. Group rides together at ~2wkg, and ride leader provides guidance and lead-outs to smash a segment; then regroup, rinse & repeat. New route every week.

Multiple time slots on Fri-Sun, including Fri Atlantic, Sun APAC and Sun Americas/EMEA.
Riders need to join ZwiftPower.com to see their results as sum of segment times.

Event links: https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/snapcracklepop
Weekly results (across all time slots): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=2656
In-ride conversation (“SCP Ride” channel): https://discord.gg/B52qdExaW2
Chat, banter and results: https://discord.gg/HNzvx98srF

Group ride with all cats together at ~2w/kg. Yellow beacon / ride leader (when present) will provide instructions for each segment, and drop the fence when it's time to punch/sprint. Fence is for guidance only (non-zapping).

Ride at a relaxed pace between the timed segments.
Work together to optimize draft for faster segment times.
Slow or stop with yellow beacon after each segment to regroup.

All categories start in a single pen.
Results split per WKG category in ZwiftPower.
No power ups, default drafting, no TT bikes.

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

name: USMeS Ridgeline Assault 2.5–5.0 w/kg
description:
Welcome to USMeS Ridgeline Assault...where Sundays are earned one climb at a time.
This is a climbing-focused ride built for riders who want sustained elevation, steady pressure, and the freedom to push hard when the road tilts up. Routes change week to week, but the mission stays the same...commit to the climb and see what you’ve got.

Pace: 2.5–5.0 w/kg (choose your effort)
Duration: 60 minutes
2 Yellow Beacons
⚡️ Lead Beacon - spicier pace off the front
⚡️ Secondary beacon — pacing the advertised effort
🚫 No fence — ride where it makes sense for you

Ride Format
• Climb heavy routes with sustained efforts on the ascents
• A focused, supportive environment where hard work is expected

Expectations
• Climbing is honest work.
• Respect all riders, ride your pace, and stay engaged.
• Every summit counts, and every effort adds up.

When the climbing is done, spin it out and recover with the Sunday Endurance Ride. The perfect way to reset after the assault.
Find your line. Hold it to the top.

name: Velos Bumper Chase Race
description:
'Bumper' races prepare horses for the biggest events, so why not cyclists? And the name 'Chase' means 'to hunt' in old French, so join Velos for our newest event: 'The Bumper' Chase Race! We change courses weekly to keep it fresh, some weeks flat & others hilly... something for every taste.

A chase-style race is loads of fun because you work with others in your CAT to try and stay ahead of the faster riders. Wait for your group’s horn to sound: Ds take off first, then staggered starts release the Cs, Bs, and As from their pens with increasingly harder efforts required. If the group behind catches you, try to work with them to the finish. Each CAT wears a different kit, making it easier to see the group you are working to catch. Chase races help you learn how to work WITH a team, since a tighter bunch means a faster group. You will master team racing skills and get stronger whilst having fun along the way: the winning formula for ALL Velos events!

Join us at teamvelos.co.uk

name: ZTPL Cycling Club Coffee Ride
description:
☀️Weszliśmy w sezon wiosenno-letni.☀️
Część naszych eventów zostaje w kalendarzu, ale może zdarzyć się tak że nie będzie na nich naszych liderów jazd.
Jeśli tak się zdarzy, gorąca prośba do Was o jazdę wg. założeń danego eventu.
Nasze eventy i liderzy ZTPL Cycling Club wrócą ponownie na jesień 2026.
Póki co RIDE ON i korzystajcie z pogody, a jeśli nie możecie to bawcie się dobrze podczas naszych eventów.

Zapraszamy na wspólny event z ZTPL Cycling Club. Pamiętajcie o wyborze właściwej grupy.
Z założenia nasze jazdy prowadzą liderzy, którzy pomagają trzymać peleton w ryzach. Jeśli podczas eventu zabraknie lidera, starajcie się trzymać tempo na które się umówiliśmy w momencie gdy dołączyliście do wybranej grupy. To od Was zależy jak będziecie się bawić 😊

Po ukończonym evencie, jeśli jechaliście z nami pierwszy raz, w Waszym wirtualnym garażu będzie czekała nasza teamowa koszulka!
◾️Grupa E jest grupą dla najbardziej początkujących. Tempo będzie dostojne 😊 i będzie oscylowało w okolicach 1.3-1.7 w/kg
◾️Grupa D jest grupą początkującą. Tempo jest spokojne, uczymy się jazdy w grupie, jest czas żeby porozmawiać. Tempo będzie nieco wyższe niż w grupie E w granicach 1.8-2.5 w/kg
◾️ Grupa C przeznaczona jest dla średnio zaawansowanych. Tempo będzie oscylować w okolicach 2.7-3.2 w/kg z przodu peletonu (możliwe akcenty).
Ważne: Jeśli wasze FTP jest w granicach 2.5w/kg to nie będzie grupa dla Was
◾️ Jeśli chcecie przejechać jazdę w tempie Coffee Ride wybierzcie o jedną grupę niżej niż sugeruje wam wasze FTP lub zwiftpower :)
◾️ Wartości podane w opisach dotyczą średniego tempa z CAŁEJ jazdy (nie uwzględniają interwałów, które mogą wystąpić podczas np. podjazdów)
◾️ PAMIĘTAJCIE że podczas jazd grupowych NIE UŻYWAMY ROWERÓW CZASOWYCH!
◾️ Starajcie się pilnować peletonu i nie zgubić koła, samemu bardzo trudno jest odrobić stratę.
◾️ Proszę słuchajcie poleceń lidera, które podczas jazdy wyświetlane są na środku ekranu.
◾️ Lider, który prowadzi grupę podświetlony jest na żółto.
◾️ Starajcie się jechać blisko lidera, starając się go nie wyprzedać i nie wyjeżdżać przed bramę, która informuje Was że jedziecie za szybko.
Proszę stosujcie się do poleceń lidera!
Szczególnie jeśli lider zauważy że grupa się porwała.

name: PACK Run Hill Training: Surrey
description:
PACK Hill Training is a group workout designed to help runners get familiar with running with incline. This is a free run event meaning there is no set pace you must go, but there will be incline prompts that attempt to mimic the terrain of the course. The inclines are based on distance, so you will always be given prompts based on your progression in the workout. If some of the gradients are too challenging for you, feel free to decrease the incline, but don't make it too easy. The leader will typically follow the pace chart below, but may adjust depending on the group dynamics.

Note: We will not always be matching Zwift gradients, so it is important to pay attention to the instructions. Typically the adjusted incline will be half of what is being displayed in the upper righthand corner.

As a general guide:
--------------------------
0 - 1% = 10.2kph / 6.3 mph
2% - 9.9 kph / 6.2 mph
3% = 9.7 kph / 6.0 mph
4% = 9.3 kph / 5.8 mph
5% = 9 kph / 5.6 mph
6% = 8.7 kph / 5.4 mph
7% = 7.4 kph / 5.2 mph
--------------------------

If you'd like Zwift to record your elevation in the fit file, you'll need to either have a direct connect treadmill or use an app like Pascal's Runcline for iOS, TSS app for iOS, or Runn module from North Pole Engineering.

Finally, if the hills don't wear you out, there will be an optional 500 meter sprint to the finish and optional after party of 2-4km to boot!

So put PACK in your name, get your black shirt and shorts on, and let's tackle those hills!

https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftpack/

Beacons: Yellow beacon sets the pace + Red beacon to support riders off the back. Sometimes we let Red off his leash though... so be prepared for that
Fence: In use to keep the group tight—we’ll drop it for sprints and segments, but regroup quickly

Ride Format:

    • Consistent endurance pacing
    • Sprints and segments called out in advance—chase your PRs!
    • Regroup behind the beacon after each effort
    • Friendly, supportive vibe with plenty of wheels to help if you drift back

Expectations:
 Hold steady tempo between efforts
 Respect the fence when active
 Use sprints to push yourself, then quickly fall back into formation

If you’re looking for a well-paced endurance ride to finish your week strong, Sunday Endurance Ride is the place to be.

name: ZZRC Ride With Friends 1.3-1.5
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Ride With Friends 1.5. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.3-1.5. on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be 1.5

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .

We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel
https://discord.gg/teHeHABDHc

TOP TIPS
1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!
2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone
3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: EVOLVE 25km Road Race
description:
Join Team Evolve for the EVOLVE 25, an electrifying 25km race on Zwift, utilizing the Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) system to match cyclists of all levels in a dynamic, community-driven virtual peloton. 

This Category Enforced event requires a smart trainer/power meter and heart rate monitor, grouping riders by their ZRS (0-1000 scale), fostering a competitive yet fair atmosphere.

ZRS FAQ: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh

About Us
At Team Evolve, we are more than just a group of athletes we are a dynamic and inclusive community united by our passion for a wide range of activities, both virtual and outdoor. 

Whether you’re into structured training, social rides, running, swimming, or simply staying active in any form, you’ll discover a welcoming and supportive environment here.

For more information visit our website www.teamevolve.cc and join us on our Discord Server: https://discord.gg/teamevolve

name: GIANT du Tour - Flat - Race
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing have partnered with GIANT cycling and The Warrior Games (TWG) to bring to you GIANT du Tour in celebration of the Le Tour Femmes

9 Stages in 9 days just like the Tour - To keep things simple these are Public races by PACE Group (A-D) with mass release and 4 time options each day.

GIANT du Tour is MEN only - Racing
LIV du Tour is WOMEN only - Racing
Ride du Tour is offered by Bikealicious each day - Banded Group rides 

REGISTER for inclusion in RACING results

Tours are tracking GC, Polka Dot (climbers) and Green Jersey (sprinters) - ALL segments are in play and ALL are FASTEST through segment - check the rules on how this will work and how we track GC - if you are new to racing it will be a great event to get you going!

For all details and RACING RULES visit our website (link below)
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD groups (links on website)

Discord - LIV-GIANT du Tour channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the event

FRR Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS
TWG Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/Eepzzf4xQP
FCC Invite link: https://discord.gg/PucjATepvy


Smart Trainers & HRM - for RACING
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Heart rate monitors are advised

Race Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt or you feel unwell please STOP there will be another day.

name: Team CLS Chill 'n' Spin Sunday Ride
description:
It’s time to join Team CLS for our Sunday Chill ‘n’ Spin ride… and UNLOCK our awesome Team CLS Kit.

Spin the legs and enjoy some banter. While stronger riders may choose to use this event as a recovery ride, this will also be an opportunity to get in a solid ride at mid D cat pace.

The focus is on riding with the bunch around the beacon as closely as possible. We see this ride as being a great event for riders that are:
- New to zwift, or have not tried a group ride before
- Recovering from injury
- Looking for a controlled group ride at D cat pace
- Easing back on the intensity and want a ride with plenty of chat.

Like all our events please make sure you can hold the above pace as we cannot reduce this at the expense of other riders although we will help to tow you back for dropouts etc.

WARNING - Please only attempt sneaky sprints on this ride if you feel your legs are sufficiently warmed up to do so. Sudden high intensity efforts on cold muscles is not advised. 


WEEKLY PROGRAM
Mon  18:50 UK - Team CLS Racing - Pace ‘n’ Race: Recon and Activation 
Tues 18:50 UK - This ‘n’ That - Endurance Training
Wed  18:50 UK - Ride ‘n’ Explore Club Rideout
Thur 18:50 UK - High ‘n’ Low - Interval Training
Sat  08:50 and 14:45 UK - Base ‘n’ Banter Endurance ride
Sun  18:50 UK - Chill 'n' Spin - Weekend Social

Check out www.teamclscc.co.uk ...find out about our club, current events and leaders. 

Facebook Club Site - https://www.facebook.com/groups/teamclscc
Facebook Racing Site - https://www.facebook.com/groups/teamclsracing

name: Bikealicious Climbalicious
description: We are a friendly gathering of cycling enthusiasts. We ride for 120 minutes, and for no less than 20 miles. You can ride with us 30 minutes or the full 2 hours. We ride a new climbing route every Sunday (edt) to keep the workout fresh and fun for all the zwifters. We ride with a rubber band to motivate all skill sets to stay together through challenging climbs resulting in an interactive and dynamic workout. Our group includes riders of all power levels. We welcome all riders.

name: HerD Beginner Races
description:
Where do you go to try racing or to grow a little better with your racing craft… Herd Beginner Races is set up to provide you with that opportunity by using Zwift Racing Scores (ZRS) with bandwidths that are set up so you’re competing with people of similarities and routes that enable you to challenge yourself and grow with racing. Our pens are set up so you're racing with others of similar abilities. Zwift will recommend your pen in blue; you can race in a higher up pen but it's not recommended.

Each week HBR races will have a different focus; racing on a flat route, rolling/undulating with a small climbs, and a route that is commonly used in many Zwift racing events. In addition, the last race of the month will be Tick-Tock so that you can monitor your performance.

name: GTR - Alpe Du Zwift Race
description:
Race the full Road to Sky route and finish with a climb up Zwift's most famous road, the Alpe Du Zwift. 

Race in pace categories A-D. 

This race is hosted by the Good Time Riders, GTR, an online bunch of friends from across the world who enjoy riding, racing hard, and generally having a good time together. Everyone is very welcome, you can find us on the Companion App, Facebook and Discord.

name: GardaBikeHotel Social Ride
description:
Welcome to Garda Bike Hotel social ride! We are a Bike Hotel on beautiful Lake Garda, Italy. We are specialized in cycling vacations and when here with us, our guests will experience the culture and beauty of our location, the breath taking riding routes, the local cuisine and the wine tasting. We also offer combined tours to other iconic cycling destinations including Stelvio, Dolomites, Piedmont, Adriatic Coast, Rome, Tuscany and Lake Como.

The aim of this inclusive Zwift ride is to have fun, be friendly and connect with our growing community around the world. All of our rides will be led by one of our friendly professional cycling guide. The route will change every week and we will try to keep the ride at around 2.0 watts per kg to make sure everyone can join in and enjoy the fun. We are an official PINARELLO rental centre and on our Zwift rides we will be riding a beautiful Pinarello Dogma F12!

To find out more about Garda Bike Hotel, please visit our website at https://www.gardabikehotel.com/en

Facebook: Garda Bike Hotel
Instagram: gardabikehotel

name: Know No Bounds Ride
description:
Welcome to the #KnowNoBounds Ride! A ride where we explore the boundaries (or lack thereof) on Zwift.
The ride will begin with 30 minutes at 3 w/kg, utilizing the fence to keep riders together. At the end of the 30 minutes, riders are free to do as they please:
they can stay together and explore the chosen course for the day, or they can head off to the nearest mountain with friends and race it!

When the 30 minute "fenced" portion of the ride is over, we will #KnowNoBounds. Have bike, will travel.
If needed, you will be able to turn to ride in opposite direction on the circuit to reconnect with the group quicker (if you need restroom or are dropped),
and most importantly, the group is not limited to the in-game courses. We can choose to go up a mountain, along a riverside, or any road we want to!

We’re on a mission: to set everyday cyclists free to explore without limits. And we’re going by bike.

Community and camaraderie in cycling is everything: group chat on this ride is highly encouraged!

name: ZSUN Sunday Social Ride
description:

Pen C starts first (2.4–2.6 w/kg), with Pen D (1.5–1.7 w/kg) following shortly after – giving riders the chance to drop back and find their sweet spot.

name: Rhino Crash Chase Race
description:
🏁 Rhino Crash Chase Race – Team Up, Stay Away, Win Big!
Ready to flip the script on solo racing? In the Rhino Chase, it’s all about teamwork within your category to outpace the others and reach the line first. Set aside rivalries and ride smart—your group’s success depends on it.

🚴 Staggered Category Start:
Category D kicks off first, followed by C, then B, and finally A.
The goal? Stay away and avoid being caught by the chasing categories!

📊 Race Format:
Standard Zwift categories with category enforcement in effect.
Weekly adjustments to time gaps and distances based on course selection to keep finishes tight and thrilling.

⚙️ Requirements:
Power Meter required to enter the pen.
Heart Rate Monitor mandatory for official results.

🎙️ Join the Conversation: Hop into the Rhino Discord (Public Crash voice channel) where we’ll be calling time gaps and cheering each other on. Everyone’s welcome!

name: HCT Unleashed : Sunday Service
description:
Welcome to HCT Unleashed: Sunday Service.

The week is almost over. Have you paid your dues to the Cycling Gods? This is your final chance to empty the tank and find redemption in a short, sharp Sunday evening sufferfest.

The format is a chaotic mass start, with all categories unleashed at once. But here's the twist: while you can work with—or against—anyone on the course, your official results are only against riders in your own category.

Use the bunch to your advantage. Bridge a gap with a stronger rider or launch a late attack. It’s all part of the game. Join us every week for 20-40 minutes of tactical, high-octane racing.

If you like racing with HCT or are just looking for a racing community to get involved with, join the team on Zwift Power - ""Herts County Triathletes"" https://zwiftpower.com/team.php?id=19017 - and Captain Dan will be in touch to get you set up with the Discord Server.

description:

name: RollCo: Night Shift
description:
Night Shift is Rolling Collectives after-hours ritual race.

When the lights drop and the noise fades, this is where racing gets raw. Short, sharp courses. Mixed terrain.  No hiding behind long climbs or safe pacing. From the first pedal stroke, it’s on.
Night Shift is built for riders who race on feel and instinct. Attacks come hard, selections happen fast, and hesitation costs you. You don’t wait for the race to start, you make it.

This is late-night racing for those who like it intense, imperfect and alive. All in, after dark.

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

name: The Grind Finale
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

This session aims to replicate the demands of a mountain bike ride / event. 

Mountain biking generally involves far more variations in effort compared with road riding - so plenty of surges and time spent being over geared! We also spend a lot of time on and off the power, so short spells going  hard to get over an obstacle, followed by a freewheel or very low power on a descent or little dip.

We touch upon all of these aspects in todays session, as we start off alternating every 30 seconds between riding hard at a low cadence, and riding easy - as if we are riding through an undulating single track. Then we make a ramp in effort, which finishes with a 30 second near max effort up a steep, rocky banking!

WORKOUT DESIGNER

Matt Rowe - Heavily involved in cycling for the past 25 years, Matt represented Great Britain at the Junior World Championships before graduating to the pro ranks. Matt draws on his extensive race experience to help amateur cyclists around the world achieve their personal goals. 

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: EVO CC Sprint Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO sprintrace series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

name: Sunday Funday p/b TBR
description:
Come hang with some friendly peeps on TBR’s D-friendly ride! We roll together in a big, happy bunch at an average 2.0w/kg pace.

We don’t use the fence in favor of control and respect for the ride leader and listed pace. Our rides are fence free and whinge free, if you stick to the leader’s Yellow Beacon like a bear to honey you will enjoy the benefits of a group draft along with lots of friendly banter. We want you to have a happy spin on the bike!

We may be The Big Ring and known for powerful riders, but our tent is also big and we encourage riders comfortable at a social pace to meet our friendly crew and learn about the TBR Effect. We are all about supporting riders in a friendly environment and helping people feel comfortable gradually working up to a faster pace. At TBR, we love to help riders look inside themselves and discover the hidden power within.

Follow The Big Ring (TBR) at www.thebigring.cc

name: LGBTQz Ride with Pride
description:
Everyone is welcome to join LGBTQ Zwifters and friends as we Ride with Pride all
year round in our Sunday social ride.
Our social ride is all about togetherness and most rides will use the rubberband so
we can be one big, joyful bunch cruising the roads where everyone belongs. No
surges, no stress, no getting left behind.
If the leader isn’t using the rubberband, they will let you know, but they’ll aim to
maintain a social pace. You can check the event details to see if this is the case for
this ride by using the link 'Toggle Event Details' at the end of the event description on
zwift.com.
Ride leaders may have quizzes or other fun stuff planned for you, so please do get
involved using the companion app chat function.
Our rides are inclusive, we value diversity and courage, and we are always
respectful. Ride chat may involve LGBTQIA+ topics so please come with an open
heart and open mind. If you want to enjoy a relaxed ride with an amazing community,
this is your space. Ride proud, ride together, and let’s make the miles brighter.
If you want to learn more about what to expect on one of our rides, or find links to our
Club and socials, please visit: https://lgbtq-zwifters.com/

description:

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

Come and join the fastest growing running club on Zwift.  With a choice of 5 or 10k you can pick your distance. Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it’s not a race unless you want it to be!

You will run in our in game NPRC jersey and if you complete the event you get to keep it to wear wherever you like.

We also hold special events where you can win an actual jersey to wear in real life.

NPRC Facebook – We have a facebook group where you can join and talk about all things running.  Share your stories and get help and advice.

https://www.facebook.com/groups/1223724692417314/

NoblePro: - We are a team focused on elevating running through our treadmills and digital platforms. We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

Kinni:- In a fitness world where treadmill bluetooth integration can be a confusing place, we aim to provide you with the ability to effortlessly connect. You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.
https://kinni.co/https://kinni.co/devices/ - To see if your treadmill is compatible to link to Zwift.

description:
Race the full Road to Sky route and finish with a climb up Zwift's most famous road, the Alpe Du Zwift. 

Race in pace categories A-D. 

This race is hosted by the Good Time Riders, GTR, an online bunch of friends from across the world who enjoy riding, racing hard, and generally having a good time together. Everyone is very welcome, you can find us on the Companion App, Facebook and Discord.

name: FRR Weekend Warrior Series - SCRATCH
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our WEEKEND WARRIOR which build on the Classica races and the full series to mid August.

Each event will offer 3 races Friday to Sunday, using three formats - iTT / Scratch / Points - each race will convert to points, based on segments and finish - a riders points total will be drawn from all 3 races, do more, score more!

Each event will center around the type of course and terrain of the monument, with the actual race day event being of a length that is fitting for the monument.

Classica races are part of the FRR Weekend Warrior Race Series for which there will be at least 10 WW events, refer to website for the Schedule and rules:

Series Schedule
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-schedule/

Rules
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-rules

Event Basics
- Public events - MIXED RACING
- Five Max 30day ZRS ranged pens
- Mandatory racing experience - HRM - Smart Trainers


- Season long Order of Merit (OoM)
- Best 7 scoring events to count (an event counts the points from all 3 races over

FRR Registered riders form the OoM - Top 10 earn prizes on condition they are FRR Subscribers 

For all details, registration and how to become an FRR subscriber vist our website:
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD

Discord - RACE channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the series

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers - HRM
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform 
- HRMs are mandatory

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

name: GIANT du Tour - Flat - Race
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing have partnered with GIANT cycling and The Warrior Games (TWG) to bring to you GIANT du Tour in celebration of the Le Tour Femmes

9 Stages in 9 days just like the Tour - To keep things simple these are Public races by PACE Group (A-D) with mass release and 4 time options each day.

GIANT du Tour is MEN only - Racing
LIV du Tour is WOMEN only - Racing
Ride du Tour is offered by Bikealicious each day - Banded Group rides 

REGISTER for inclusion in RACING results

Tours are tracking GC, Polka Dot (climbers) and Green Jersey (sprinters) - ALL segments are in play and ALL are FASTEST through segment - check the rules on how this will work and how we track GC - if you are new to racing it will be a great event to get you going!

For all details and RACING RULES visit our website (link below)
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD groups (links on website)

Discord - LIV-GIANT du Tour channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the event

FRR Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS
TWG Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/Eepzzf4xQP
FCC Invite link: https://discord.gg/PucjATepvy


Smart Trainers & HRM - for RACING
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Heart rate monitors are advised

Race Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt or you feel unwell please STOP there will be another day.

name: ZLDR AYOP Event
description:
Start your day on the right foot or the left. Come to our 5k at your own pace (AYOP). Run, walk, chat, laugh and get your day moving on a positive note! Attitude is 90% of any situation so let’s make this day the best day and get you in the best mindset so you can be the best you!

ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. We are here to support your running dreams and help you develop your running skills. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners and walkers who want to help you set and achieve new goals!

name: OTR Tempo Group Ride
description:
Come join OTR for our weekly Tempo Group Ride. Courses will rotate weekly on shorter circuit routes so slower riders off the back have a chance to rejoin the group. The Yellow Beacon ride leaders will guide you through a mix of sprints, tempo, and recovery laps. Be careful, the fence is live and will zap you if you fly off the front! The final lap is an optional race pace lap and a chance to give it all you got!

B group will focus on riding together at an average pace between 2.8 - 3.2 w/kg.
D group will focus on riding together at an average pace between 1.8 - 2.2 w/kg.

Join us for some conversation during the ride on our OTR discord channel at: https://discord.gg/WjY7EuAMv4

If you are interested in racing with OTR please reach out to any OTR team member. We are happy to help you meet your racing goals!

name: Zwift TT Club Racing - Monmartre Mixer
description:
The Time Trial. Cycling’s true leveler - just you and your legs versus everyone else in the field.

Come join Zwift TT Club on Zwift for more Time Trial event information! https://www.zwift.com/clubs/b3d1a903-df49-44eb-9c6f-4ba9f0622efe/home

Join us as we embark on a series of events - each week you will have multiple chances to set your best time on the same route!

Over the course of the series, we’ll be using routes in the region of 15-25km.

Check out Zwiftpower.com after your event to see how well you stack up against the competition!

Don’t forget to check you’re using the fastest bike frame and wheels available to you!

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. name: NPRC - Run Every Day Powered By NoblePro
description:
Come and join the fastest growing running club on Zwift.  With a choice of 5 or 10k you can pick your distance. Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it’s not a race unless you want it to be!

Each day is a different route and as new routes are released the courses will change to allow you to bag that badge.

You will run in our in game NPRC jersey and if you complete the event you get to keep it to wear wherever you like.

We also hold special events where you can win an actual jersey to wear in real life.

NPRC Facebook – We have a facebook group where you can join and talk about all things running.  Share your stories and get help and advice.

https://www.facebook.com/groups/1223724692417314/

NoblePro: - We are a team focused on elevating running through our treadmills and digital platforms. We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

Kinni:- In a fitness world where treadmill bluetooth integration can be a confusing place, we aim to provide you with the ability to effortlessly connect. You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.
https://kinni.co/https://kinni.co/devices/ - To see if your treadmill is compatible to link to Zwift.

Join the NoblePro Running Club (NPRC) - https://www.zwift.com/clubs/e7829ccd-bce4-4244-9ccf-4cdc3ef148ff/home

This is a twice weekly interval event which is targeted at riders looking to develop strength and endurance.
The events are open to all riders not just category B , but also those moving from rides of lower intensity.

advertised power range based on a 75kg rider .

name: 3R VOLT Interval Ride [~2.6-3.2 w/kg avg]
description:
This is a 3R Group Ride so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the keeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack. 3R VOLT runs five days a week and is designed to provide a solid and fun training platform for riders.

Different ride leaders target different effort levels and courses, with power averages in the range 2.8-3.2 w/kg.

The wide spread reflects the diversity of rides and training needs, the following is a typical week:
Monday – After what has hopefully been a fun backed weekend on the bike, this our recovery session
Tuesday – Tends to be more of a classic interval session, riders usually finish with an average of around 3.0w/kg
Wednesday – We take to the hills and one of our tougher sessions with riders averaging around 3.2w/kg
Thursday – is our no red beacon ride and again tough interval sets and riders finishing around 3.2w/kg
Friday - is a little different, we don't take ourselves too seriously and often play a variety of games and quizzes along side the intervals and riders end up with around 2.8-3.0w/kg

The rides are typically around an hour long, but some may take up to 75mins with the majority finishing with either a ramp or a mini race.

The group welcomes rider interaction through messaging and the VOLT discord server and features a friendly bunch of regulars to which newcomers, and riders stepping up from lower intensity rides, are always welcome. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/

This group ride is not a race so. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/ #Team3R #Ride3R #RideRaceRaise.

name: 3R SPARK Steady State Ride [~2.0-2.2 w/kg avg]
description: This is a 3R Group Ride Event (not a race). 3R Spark runs five days a week and is designed to be an accessible and sociable training session, aimed primarily at riders in Cat-D. Different ride leaders target different effort levels and courses, with power averages in the range 2.0-2.5 W/kg. The wide spread reflects the diversity of rides. Mondays and Tuesdays are our entry-level steady-state rides, where we aim to hold a steady 2.0-2.2 throughout. Thursdays and Fridays are our interval sessions, designed to help Cat D riders push themselves a little further. For interval sessions we aim to average between 2.2-2.5 for the session, but there will be times above and below. Thursday and Friday sessions often include an optional mini-race at the end. Wednesday is the Taylor Zwift Fan Club ride, a led by the hosts of the popular podcast of the same name – expect a sociable steady-state session with lots to keep you entertained! The TZFC ride is livestreamed at twitch.tv/TaylorZwiftFC. Rides are typically around an hour long. Spark is a great introduction to group rides on Zwift, we are a friendly and supportive group who love to see one another succeed. We always have a sweeper (red beacon) whose wheel you can grab if you get dropped. There’s always plenty of good chat, via in-ride messages or on Discord. Come and join us! Join the 3R Facebook group for more info: https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/ #Team3R #3R #RideRaceRaise

name: 3R Octane Interval Ride [~3.2-3.6 w/kg avg]
description:
This is a 3R Group Ride Event. 3R Octane runs five days a week and is designed to provide a solid and fun training platform for riders.

Different ride leaders target different effort levels and courses, with power averages in the range 3.2-3.8 W/kg.

The wide spread reflects the diversity of rides, including weekly recovery, or transitional, rides which are usually on a Monday. Short, high intensity intervals, longer sweetspot intervals, flying laps, long and short climbs and exploring little used routes all feature.

The rides are typically around an hour long, but some can be up to two hours long, and all end with a mini race.

The Group welcomes rider interaction through messaging and the Octane discord server and features a super bunch of regulars to which newcomers, and riders stepping up from lower intensity rides, are always welcome. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/

#Team3R #Ride3R #RideRaceRaise #3r

name: GIANT du Tour - Hilly - Race
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing have partnered with GIANT cycling and The Warrior Games (TWG) to bring to you GIANT du Tour in celebration of the Le Tour Femmes

9 Stages in 9 days just like the Tour - To keep things simple these are Public races by PACE Group (A-D) with mass release and 4 time options each day.

GIANT du Tour is MEN only - Racing
LIV du Tour is WOMEN only - Racing
Ride du Tour is offered by Bikealicious each day - Banded Group rides 

REGISTER for inclusion in RACING results

Tours are tracking GC, Polka Dot (climbers) and Green Jersey (sprinters) - ALL segments are in play and ALL are FASTEST through segment - check the rules on how this will work and how we track GC - if you are new to racing it will be a great event to get you going!

For all details and RACING RULES visit our website (link below)
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD groups (links on website)

Discord - LIV-GIANT du Tour channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the event

FRR Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS
TWG Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/Eepzzf4xQP
FCC Invite link: https://discord.gg/PucjATepvy


Smart Trainers & HRM - for RACING
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Heart rate monitors are advised

Race Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt or you feel unwell please STOP there will be another day.

name: Mountain Massif structured training:  Tempo Efforts 2
description:
Created by Matteo Cigala, from Cigala Cycling, this structured training session is designed to help you cycle at a higher intensity.  For coaching and all your training needs visit https://coaching.cigalacycling.com/trainsmarterridefaster

About the session:
This session builds aerobic readiness, controlled tempo and threshold exposure, and sustained tempo endurance. The warm up prepares the athlete for early intensity changes. The tempo and threshold blocks elevate heart rate and activate muscular engagement without creating unnecessary fatigue. The main tempo sets focus on maintaining strong, steady power while holding a smooth, efficient cadence. Recovery intervals ensure quality and repeatability across all sets. The cool down supports gradual heart-rate reduction and full metabolic clearance.
Session details:
Warm Up 
5 min 40–65% CP 100–110 rpm

1 x Tempo 
3 min 80% CP Free cadence

1 x Threshold 
1 min 95% CP Free cadence

Recovery 
5 min 50–60% CP 100–110 rpm

3 x Tempo Sets 
8 min 75–90% CP 100–110 rpm
5 min recovery between sets 50–60% CP 90–100 rpm

Cool Down 
5 min 40–55% CP 100–110 rpm

Total Time: 58 minutes

Key coaching cues:
Keep transitions between intensities smooth and controlled. Hold steady power during tempo and threshold efforts without drifting upward. Maintain relaxed upper-body posture and consistent breathing. Use recoveries to reset cadence and technique before the next block. Stay focused on smooth, efficient pedalling during the longer tempo sets. 

Safety Note: 
Only undertake vigorous exercise if you are fit and healthy to do so. If you are at all unsure, consult a Physician or Doctor first. All training equipment including Bikes and Turbo trainers should be in full working order. Do not use any piece of equipment that does not come up to the required standard.
More information:
For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram @mountain_massif, Facebook @mountainmassif and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home
To record all your training data and chart your progress, consider using the TrainingPeaks app or Vekta by following the link https://joinvekta.com/

name: SZR Sunrise Ride
description:
Welcome to SZR Sunrise

This is a group ride with the focus on remaining together.
The average pace PRIOR to any race finish will be 2.2 wkg. Suitable for D riders looking to become C’s and above
Sprints and intervals will be added at the discretion of the leader.
We will at times ride above and below the advertised pace, please don’t feel the need to tell the leader they will be aware!

Please regroup quickly after sprints, intervals or hills and sit between the yellow and red beacons.
This is not a recovery ride, we work hard and work as a team.

name: Monday Roll Out
description:
The QueenBees are a group of women who share a love of cycling. Just as a hive works together to bring out the best in every member of the community, so do we. We strive to support, empower and encourage women to live their best lives, no matter where they are on their life, cycling or fitness journey. Join us for a social ride, all abilities welcome pace will be around 1.5-1.8 wkg. During the ride try to stay with the yellow lead beacon and follow instructions from your ride leader.

Join our QueenBee hive here (ladies only): https://www.facebook.com/groups/218570110355444

name: Liv du Tour Your Way
description:
Join us for a fun, social, banded group ride following the same route as the Liv du Tour racers. Whether you’re looking to enjoy the atmosphere, ride with friends, or simply celebrate cycling, this ride is for you—no racing, no pressure, just great company and shared miles.



This tour is a celebration of the Tour de France Femmes and the incredible women who inspire our sport. Everyone is welcome.



*Daily Routes (1–9 August 2026)



1 August – Downtown Dolphin (15 laps)
2 August – Magnificent 8 (29 km)
3 August – Chasing the Sun (35 km)
4 August – Epic Loch (2 laps)
5 August – Casse-Pattes (24 km)
6 August – Figure 8 Reverse (30 km)
7 August – Ven-Top (20.9 km)
8 August – Sugar Cookie (40 km)
9 August – Mayan 8 (26.2 km)

eventSubgroups.name: Liv du Tour Your Way (E)
eventSubgroups.description:
This is a social ride welcoming all riders. Our mission is to push you further than before, build your endurance, and have fun. If you are feeling strong, push to the front and drag the group, if not, just sit in the peloton.

We have the “rubber-band” activated, which means that it’s a no drop ride - no matter what level you are, you will be able to keep up, and the group WILL STAY TOGETHER. Note: The overall speed may be lower than in other rides due to the banding effect.

So hop on that bike, grab those bottles, and let’s ride!

name: ZZRC Bring a Bidon Social Ride
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Bring a Bidon 2.4-2.7. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2.4-2.7 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicate a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us
on Discord: https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: GXY MONDAY COFFEE CRUISE [2.3-2.8wkg] – CAT C
description:
Welcome to GXY Monday Coffee Cruise!
Our weekly steady state ride here to ease you into the week ahead.
We will achieve this together by providing a consistent pace to help you build both your strength and stamina at the
lower to middle area of the Cat C range of power.
The ride leader and support team will after 60 minutes bring you to the end of the ride within the advertised power
range! (expect an approximate 2.5 -2.6wkg ride average depending on body size and course selection)
The event is designed to maintain or increase base level fitness of riders. Please respect the leader’s pace and watch

name: ZLDR Easy 30
description:

description:

description:

With runs in seven time slots with four pace groups each (A being the fastest and D being the slowest), there’s an event for everyone.

A) 7.5–8.5 mph // 12–14 kph
B) 7–7.5 mph // 10.5–12 kph
C) 6–6.5 mph // 9.5–10.5 kph
